tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /zab lam ni gu chos drug gi khrid yig zab don thang mar brdal ba zhes bya ba bklags chog ma bzhugs/

na mo gu ru/ zab lam ni gu'i chos drug gi khrid yig zab don thang mar brdal ba zhes bya ba/ pha bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsol ba 'debs so/ / skyabs su mchi'o/ /byin gyis rlobs shig/bla ma dang ni rdo rje 'chang*/ /tha dad nyid du ma dmigs pas/ /bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs yid dbyer med ngang du gnas/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun lha zhes jo bo dkon mchog gsum/ /grub mchog dbang po'i tshul 'dzin zhu bde'i ye shes phyogs brgyar 'bar/ /chos kyi sku las ma g.yos snyan pa'i grags pas sa gsum khyab/ /srid zhi kun dang mnyam nyid khyed la rtag par phyag bgyi'o/ /man ngag zab mo mtha' yas kyang*/ /yid ches mngon rtags nyams myong kun/ /dus mtha' 'dir yang 'byung 'gyur ba/ /mkha' 'gro ni gu'i zhal gdams 'di'o/ /de la 'dir ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ni gu'i chos skor 'di dag/spyir mdo rgyud thams cad kyi zab don dgongs 'dus yin la/ khyad par du yang*/ mthar thug ston pa rnam pa lnga'i rgyud ces bya ba/ gtum mo ston pa'i mthar thug dgyes mdzad dang*/ /las rgya ston pa'i mthar thug 'khor lo sdom/ /sgyu lus rmi lam mthar thug gsang 'dus dang*/ /'od gsal mthar thug mahā yā ya dang*/ / 'phrin las mthar thug rdo rje 'jigs byed do/ /zhes pa ltar/ rgyud sde lnga'i don gyi bcud phyung ba'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa zab mo yin la/ /de yang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po nas/ da lta'i bar du brgyud pa las/ gdams ngag zab mo'i brlan drod ma yal/ byin rlabs chu bo'i bka' rgyun ma nub/ grub thob brgyud pa'i zam ma chad/ nyams dang rtogs pa'i 'char sgo ma 'gags/ chos bdag mkha' 'gro'i bka' rgya ma nyams pa'i man ngag rtsod med grags pa kun khyab de yin/ de lta bu yang*/ dag pa'i sa la bzhugs pa/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal mngon sum du gzigs shing*/ gsung gi snang ba la spyod pa/

ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ni gu ma'i zhal nas/ chos 'di shes pa nga dang*/ slob dpon lwa ba pa min pa rgya gar na yang med/ de las kyang gnyid thun gcig la chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ khyod kho na las gzhan med do zhes dbugs 'byin par mdzad pa/ grub pa'i dbang phyug khyung po rnal 'byor pa/ mtshan gzhan lo tswa ba tshul khrims mgon por grags pa de nyid sku gsang ba 'dus pa/ gsung mahā mā ya/ thugs dgyes mdzad rdo rje/ yon tan 'khor lo sdom pa/ 'phrin las rdo rje 'jigs mdzad de/ ye shes dkyil 'khor lnga'i ngo bo dang gnyis su med par bzhugs la/ de ltar yin par grub thob a mo gha badzra chen pos kyang lung bstan pa/ gzhan yang mthar thug lnga ldan pa zhes/ mtshan yongs su grags pa de ni chos 'di sgyur ba po y-in no/ /chos gzhan rnams kyi lo paṇa gyi dod longs sku ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma nyid dang*/ mkhas grub chen po sprul pa'i sku de yin cing*/ de yang rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid nas brtsams te brgyud pa bdun gyi bar du snyan brgyud dang chig brgyud kyi bka' rgyas btab/ de rjes nas chos 'dis sa steng thams cad khyab 'gro bar lung bstan pa ltar dngos su'ang de ltar byung ba yin/ 'dir bka' rgya 'grol ba po gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa'i thugs kyi sras thu bo rnam pa gsum las/ mkhas grub gzhon nu grub dngos kyis khrid yig mdzad pa dang*/ mkhas grub shangs ston tshul khrims mgon gyi gsung rnams/ mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bul gyis khrid yig tu mdzad nas bla ma nyid la spyan lam du phab pa dang*/ slob dpon gnas rnying pa a'i seng ge dang*/ sprul sku rin chen blo gros kyi gsung las byon pa rnams/ gser gling pa bkra shis dpal gyis yig ris su mdzad pa rnams kyang*/ chos drug gi khrid yig sogs dmigs pa rnams zhus dag pher ba lta bur yod/ spyir chos tshul 'di skor la/

snyan brgyud yi ger 'god pa'i bka' drin che ba ni/ mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum nyid yin te/ 'di kho nas yi ger mdzad pa mang ngo*/ /de ltar na/ lugs 'di la tshad mar gyur pa'i mkhas grub rnam pa gsum gyi gdams ngag gi rgyun thams cad rang re'i chos brgyud 'di la tshang bar bzhugs/ nang gses so so nas gyes pa'i brgyud lugs mi 'dra ba nyi shu rtsa bzhi yang 'dir tshang ba lags so/ /skabs 'dir bla ma'i rnam thar rgyas pa lung bklag dgos pa'i dbang du byas na/ rnam thar rgyas pa rang ngag na bshad mi dgos kyang*/ rin chen sna bdun gyi lo rgyus che ba ci rigs pa brjod na legs so/ /'dir mkhas grub chen po khyung po rnal 'byor pa des/ rgya gar mkhas pa brgya dang lnga bcu'i thugs bcud longs pa nyid kyi phyir/ mdo sngags bshad sgrub kyi chos mtha' yas pa zhig mnga' zhing*/ gzhan la'ang gsungs tshul rags rim tsam rnam thar na bzhugs pa der gda'/ de rnams kyi nang nas deng sang ma nub par bzhugs pa rnams gzhung bsrangs/ cha lag gzhan gyis kyang cung zad brgyan te/ shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi chos skor du yongs su grags pa ltar na/ mkhas grub khyung po nyid las byung ba'i chos skor dang*/ phyis 'phel ba'i chos skor gnyis yod/ dang po la/ ni gu'i chos skor/ su kha'i chos skor/ rdo rje gdan pa'i chos skor/ mai tri pa'i chos skor/ rā hu la'i chos skor/ gzhan man ngag thor bu dang bcas pa rnams yod/ yang na smin byed dbang gi skor/ grol byed lam gyi skor/ rgyab rten lung gi skor/ bka' srung mgon po'i skor/ zhes dbye ba bzhir mdzad pa yod pa las/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu nas brgyud pa'i grol byed lam gyi skor la/ rtsa ba ni gu chos drug/sdong po phyag rgya chen po/ yal ga la lam khyer rnam gsum/ me tog mkha' spyod dkar dmar/ 'bras bu 'chi med 'chug med de/ gser chos lnga'am/ khrid chen lngar grags pa dang*/

khrid chung bdun la sogs pa/ ji snyed cig yod pa las/ dang po chos drug la/ thog ma'i sngon 'gro/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ las rgyu 'bras/ chos kyi phan yon/ 'bras bu'i bzhugs tshul sogs bstan pa la 'jug pa'i rim pa sogs dang*/ mthun par go bde bar bshad nas cung zad bsgom du gzhug go /khrid dngos la dbye na/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi'i khrid gnyis so/ /dang po la/ thun mong*/ thun mong ma yin pa gnyis so/ /dang po la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed pa gnyis so/ /de'i dang po skyabs 'gro ni/ slob dpon gyis spyir skyabs 'gro'i go babs rgyas bsdus 'tsham pa bshad cing*/ skabs 'dir dmigs pa la/ skyabs 'gro bzhi skor spyi dang mthun pa 'bog pa'i phyag len yang 'dug mod/ spros pa la dga' ba rnams kyi ngor/ de yang ma legs pa ma yin kyang*/ chos 'di nyid kyi khyad chos zab don skyabs 'gro chig 'grel ma 'di byin rlabs dang ldan pa'i zhal rgyun ma chad pa lags pas/ phyag bzhes rgyun gyi nyams len 'di la mdzad pa yin no/ /de yang dben pa'i gnas su stan bde ba la 'dug/lus gnad spyi dang mthun par bcas/ sems rnal du phab/ rang gzhan thams cad la gzhig 'grel zhig bcug/ga re bdag dang mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bzod blags med pa/ dus mtha' med par myong dgos pa 'di a tsam ci rang drag snyam du bsam/ da ni 'di las nges par skyob thub pa'i skyabs zhig dgos par 'dug na/ skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo mtshan ldan bla ma dam pa las gzhan mi 'dug pas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma kho na la cis kyang skyabs zhu dgos snyam pas/ rang nyid gang du gnas pa'i yul phyogs khang khyim kun yang dag pa'i zhing du mos/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri padma nyi zla'i gdan la drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa nyid sku dngos de ka la bkrag mdangs gzi brjid 'od du 'bar ba/

rang la dgyes pa'i zhal 'dzum bag can/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus/ chos kun 'dus/ dge 'dun kun 'dus/ dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma kun 'dus/ yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams kun 'dus/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma kun 'dus pa'i bdag nyid can yin/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma mkhyen snyam pa bya/ de nas rang gi tshe 'di'i dngos kyi pha ma dang*/ rang la gnod par byed pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ rang nyid gang du gnas pa'i yul phyogs de'i gzhi bdag rnams kyis gtso byas pa'i khams gsum sems can thams cad kyang*/ nye 'khor phyogs mtshams thams cad khyab par 'khod nas/ rang dang lhan cig tu skyabs 'gro byed par mos te/ ngag tu/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad skyabs kun 'dus kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la skyabs su mchi ba lags so/ /zhes ci nus su brjod cing*/ bdag dang sems can thams cad sngon chad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs pas 'jigs pas/ da ni khyed la skyabs zhu/ skyabs bslu ba med pa khyed la blos ling gis bkal ba lags/ re sa mgon skyabs gzhan na med do/ /thugs rje chen pos bskyab tu gsol snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po dung dung pa rgyun chags su bya/ thun 'jog khar skyabs yul bla ma de la mos gus dung ba byas pas/ de nyid 'od du ltem ste zhu nas rang la thim/ bla ma dang rang sems dbyer med du mos/ de ka'i ngang du cung zad mnyam par bzhag/de ka la thun mtshams byed na/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ dmigs skor gcig go /gnyis pa sems bskyed ni/ sngar ji skad bshad pa'i skyabs 'gro de sngon du btang nas/ slar yang rang gzhan snod bcud/ nam mkhas gar khyab sems can gyi khyab pa rnams la blos gzhig 'grel bcug ste/ ga re nam mkha' 'dis gar khyab sems can gyis khyab par 'dug/'di thams cad re re nas pha dang ma dang mdza' bshes su ma gyur pa cung zad kyang med/ de yang lan re tsam ma yin gyi/ skye ba dpag tu med par pha ma sogs su gyur pa yin/

'di rnams 'dod ni bde ba 'dod kyang*/ myong ni sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig myong ba cis kyang snying re rje/ de bas na 'di rnams sdug bsngal med cing bde ba dam pa la bdag gis 'god par bya na/ mthar thug pa na 'di rnams kyi sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs nas/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god dgos par 'dugade yang thabs gzhan gyis mi nus pas bdag gis sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/sangs rgyas de yang dam pa'i chos kyi don bsgoms pa las 'byung ba'i phyir/ da res zab lam mthar thug chos drug zab mo 'di bsgom snyam du bsam/ ngag nas 'di skad ces/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du zab lam ni gu'i chos drug nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ / zhes brjod de/ don yid la bsam dgos pas/ tshig de yang dal bus brjod cing nan tan cher bya/ thun gyi dngos gzhi'i nyams len de kho na bskyar gyin bsgom pa yin/ thun gyi mjug tu dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba re yang dgos pa lags/ dmigs skor gnyis pa'o/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la/ dag byed a'i stong ra/ stong ra nad gdon sel byed/ rtags gsum stong ra'i khyad par te/ rtsis 'go gsum du dbye ba yin/ dang po ni/ dmigs chen yin te/ de yang sngar bshad pa'i skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed lan bdun bdun tsam re sngon du btang nas/ slar yang rang gi spyi bor gdan bzhi rdzogs sam/ ji ltar 'os pa'i gdan la/ bla ma sku dngos de ka gsal btab nas/ mos gus kyi gdung shugs dang 'brel bas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che/ sems can thams cad kyi don du/ bdag gi nad gdon thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ sdig sgrib thams cad 'dag par mdzad du gsol/ ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/

/zhes gsol ba bzlas drag la yun ring du btab/ mthar bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ de yan chad 'di'i dgos kyi sngon 'gro bla ma'i rnal 'byor yin/ de yang spyi bo nas zhugs te thim pas/ klad pa gti mug gi rang bzhin can de yal ba'i tshul gyis sbyangs/ thod pa dung khang gi gzhal yas khang lta bur gyur gsung ste/ don dngos ni/ /rang tha mal du gsal ba'i lus po 'di/ da lta'i gdos bcas 'di ka yin pa'i mgrin pa yan chad gyi dbyibs rnam pa de ka yin kyang*/ nang sha khrag rus gsum spangs pa smos ci dgos/ phyi pags pa'i skya ri yang shin tu srab pa chu'i lbu ba lta bu kha dog dkar ba zhag tu bsam/ mgo bo'i nang du chos 'byung dkar po gru gsum pa/ khong stong dwangs gsal shel gyi snod lta bu/ rtsa ba phra ba thur du bstan pa mgrin pa'i mtshams su slebs/ gdengs ka che ba gyen du bstan pa la zur gsum yod pa'i zur gcig smin phrag gi thad dang*/ zur gzhan gnyis rna lcog g.yas g.yon gyi ltag tsam du nang nas pags pa la reg ge yod pa'o/ /chos 'byung de'i nang g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab gang la yang ma yo ba'i dbus drang thad du/ bla ma dang rang sems dbyer med spros bral skye med mtshon pa'i a yig dkar po dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can 'od dkar po shin tu 'tsher ba 'phro ba/ chos 'byung gi kha mtshams dang a yig gi mgrin pa'i nyeg mtshams mtho dman mnyam pa tsam bsgom gsung*/ gang ltar a yig gi mgo bo chos 'byung gi kha mtshams las mtho nges pa bsgom/ thog mar de lta bur bsgrims te 'bad pas gsal btab nas/ de rjes shes pa grims lhod ran po zhig gis/ a yig chos 'byung dang bcas par cung zad sems 'dzin/ de rjes a thung gi bzlas pa lan nyer gcig tsam shub shub por bzlas pas/ a las bdud rtsi'i rgyun sbom po dkar la dwangs pa 'od 'phro ba shugs dang ldan pa babs/ skad cig la chos 'byung mer gyis khengs nas chos 'byung gi kha'i phyogs thams cad nas zham zham byung*/

las kyi dbus thog thag tu shugs dang ldan par song*/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa/ gnas skabs kyi 'gal rkyen nad gdon bar chad dkor sku glud dam tshig 'gal 'khrul la sogs pa thams cad phyir bdas par bsam dgos/ /sdig sgrib la dngos su kha dog med kyang dmigs pa gsal ba'i phyir dang*/ rten 'brel nus pa sna tshogs pa'i khyad par gyi phyir/ sdig sgrib sogs de dag rnams thams cad dud khu'am sol khu lta bu'i rnam pas/ rgyun sbom pa rnams bu ga dgu nas mi shong tshad par 'gro ba dang*/ 'bring po rnams rkang lag gi sen mo'i phrag dang*/ phra ba rnams skra'i rtse mo dang ba spu'i khung bu tshun chad nas kyang nag nu ru ru thon 'gro bar bsam/ de yang bdud rtsi dwangs gsal gyi rgyun gang du slebs pa'i mtshams de nas/ nad gdon sdig sgrib rnams sdod dbang med par steng nas 'og tu bdas 'gro ba dang*/ dbus nas mtha' la bdas 'gro bar bsam/ lus kyi sha khrag rus pa sogs mi gtsang ba'i rdzas thams cad kyang zhu ba ltar song nas/ sdig sgrib rnams dang lhan cig tu gar song med pa'i tshul gyis dag/de ltar lus kyi nad thams cad bkrus/ yang bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun skra dang ba spu'i rtsa ba nas phyir song ba rnams kyis lus kyi phyi nang kyang bkrus/ lus dwangs gsal dkar ba/ pags pa'i skya ri tsam la shel snod srab mo 'dra ba/ nang bdud rtsi dwangs gsal gyis gang ba'am/ yang na 'ja' 'od dkar po las grub pa lta bur song bar bsam/ phyi la bdas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib rnams nag bun nu nus ngogs thag ring por song zhing*/ de yang yal bar bsam la/ de dag dmigs pa 'jur po bar ma chad par bsgoms pa'i rjes la/ ngal gso ba'i tshul gyis shes pa dar cig glod la bzhag/de yan chad dmigs pa tshar gcig yin/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mgo'i de kas chog pas thun de nang du slar bskyar mi dgos/

dmigs pa dngos gzhi de yang yang bskyar gyin bsgom/ de yang dper na thun re'i nang du dmigs pa lan brgya rtsa tsam/ thun yang bzhi lnga drug tsam bsgom thub na/ zhag bdun sogs la rtags myur bar 'ong*/ /des mtshon te rang gi rtsol ba rab 'bring tha gsum dang sbyor ba'i rtags myur bul gyi khyad par 'byung ba yin no/ /'di'i sdig sgrib dag par bsam pa'i skabs/ lus thogs med 'ja' tshon lta bur sgom na gsal nyams 'char rig pa dwangs/ bdud rtsis gang bar bsgoms na lus zungs bzang*/ shel gong g.ya' dag pa lta bur bsgoms na/ rmi lam gsal snang skye ba yin gsung ngo*/ /dmigs skor gsum pa'o/ gnyis pa stong ra nad gdon sel byed la nad sel ba dang*/ gdon sel ba gnyis yod/ de re re la yang dbye ba du ma yod mod kyi so sor na dmigs phran yang yin/ spyir nas dag byed a'i stong ra'i las tshogs tsam yin pas/ yongs bsdaums nas dmigs chen gcig gi don du brtsi dgos/ de yang nad tshad pa lta bu la/ a las bdud rtsis rgyun kha dog dkar ba/ reg bya dang nus pa gnyis kar bsil ba'i rgyun babs te/ tsha ba'i gnas stod kyi yul lam/ gang nas de ka nas bu ga har re byung sgo de ka nas nad tsha ba de yang dmar 'dur 'dur phyir bdas par bsam/ de bzhin du nad grang ba la/ bdud rtsi kha dog dmar po reg bya dang nus pa gnyis ka tsha ba babs te/ grang ba'i yul ro smad kyi cha'am/ gang na sa nas brdol te nad thams cad dkar 'dur 'dur 'dur thon par bsam/ rlung gi nad la bdud rtsi kha dog ser ba mar khu ltar bcud dang ldan pa babs/ lus kyi cha thams cad dam/ 'og sgo gnyis sam/ gang na sar bu ga byung ste/ nad rnams sngo 'dur ba'am nag 'dur gyis thon par bsam/ yang na rlung 'tshub ma'am du ba lta bur bun bun thur du 'gro bar bsam/ snying rlung la snying gi thad ka nas bu ga byung ste/ de nas 'gro bar bsam/ des mtshon nas nad gzhan thams cad la yang rigs 'gre/

yang dmigs pa'i gzhi dag byed stong ra bzhin bsgoms nas/ a las khro bo so so'i sku'i rnam pa can gyi bdud rtsi ser ba drag po ltar 'bebs pa dang*/ khro chung gi tshogs dpag tu med pas lus kyi nang go mtshams med par gtams/ me lce yang spros te thur dang phyogs mtshams su 'bar ba dang*/ bdud rtsi khro chu bzhu ba'i rgyun lta bu yang 'bebs te/ sngags kyi sgras skrag pa dang*/ mtshon cha brdaig pa dang*/ me ris sreg pa sogs kyis gdon gyi ris srog chags sna tshogs pa'i gzugs can de rnams lus kyi nang du sdod dbang med par phyir bskrad de/ phyi rol de nyid du tshar bcad cing*/ lhag ma tsam yang ma lus par bsam mo/ gdon so so'i gnyen por khro bo gang dgos pa ni/ 'og gang 'dul gyi skabs dang 'dra'o/ khro bo dang me dang khro chu lta bu ste spro ba gsum po dus gcig tu mi yong bas rim can du bya'o/ /dmigs skor bzhi pa'o/ /gsum pa rtags gsum stong ra'i khyad par ni/ dag byed a'i stong ra bsgoms pas sdig sgrib dag pa'i rtags rab dngos su shar ba ni/ 'di bsgoms pa kho nas lus ldang ba yang ba dang*/ shes pa gsal ba dang*/ rgyud 'jam zhing blo khug 'ong*/ chags sdang sogs nyon mongs chung du 'gro ba dang*/ dad pa dang snying rje shes rab sogs rang shugs kyis cher song na'ang yin/ 'bring gnyid sad dus 'khrul snang nyams kyi tshul du 'char ba dang*/ tha ma rmi lam gsal bor 'char ba la khrus byas pa dang*/ nam mkha' la 'phur ba dang*/ gos dkar po gyon pa la sogs pa'o/ /stong ra nad sel byed bsgoms pas nad thon pa'i rtags rab ni/ nad dngos su sangs pa yin/ 'bring nyams dang tha ma rmi lam la 'khru skyugs dang*/ lus las rnag khrag thon pa sogs byung na yin/ stong ra gdon sel byed bsgoms pas/ gdon gyi gnod pa sel ba'i rtags rab/ dngos su nyer 'tshe zhing*/ lus sems dga' bde skye/ /bag bro'u re ba yong*/

'bring nyams dang*/ tha ma rmi lam la/ srog chags gdug pa can bcom pa dang*/ rang nyid dgra las rgyal ba dang*/ lus las srog chags thon pa la sogs pa 'byung ngo*/ /de la rtags gsum ni sdig sgrib dag pa'i rtags/ nad sel ba'i rtags*/ gdon sel ba'i rtags te gsum po yin la/ de re re la yang dngos dang*/ nyams dang*/ rmi lam gyi dbye ba gsum gsum ste/ nad sel rtags kyi dbye ba dgur 'gyur ba yin no/ /de la dang por rtags yong du re ba mi bya/ rtsis btab med par 'jog dgos/ rtags byung na zhen pa dang*/ rloms sems dang*/ dga' mi dga' byed du mi rung*/ 'di lta bu rten 'brel snang ba ma 'gags pa'i 'char sgo cam yin gyi/ don gang du'ang ma grub pa sgyu ma lta bu'o/ /zhes re dogs spangs te bzhag pas/ slad kyi bar chad mi 'byung zhing lam du 'gro ba yin no/ / dngos kyi rtags rnams byung na des khyab/ sad dus kyi nyams la gsal snang du shar ba yin*/ lan gcig shar ba kho nas rtags su byed/ rmi lam tsam la nges pa med pas/ shin tu gsal ba dang*/ lan mang du byung ba dang*/ sad nas kyang blo'i mdangs 'gyur tshabs che bar byung na rtags su byed pa lags so/ /rtags kyi rnam bzhag rgyas par yig rnying na gsal/ 'di la dmigs thun bcad pa'i dmigs pa med kyang*/ rtags shar ba lam du srol tshul de ka dmigs pa yin pas/ dmigs skor lnga pa'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ gtum mo/ sgyu lus/ rmi lam/ 'od gsal/ 'pho ba/ bar do ste drug yin la/ de dag kyang rang rang gi byed las che ba dang bcas pa brjod na/ thabs lam bde drod rang 'bar/ sgyu lus chags sdang rang grol/ rmi lam nying 'khrul rang dga'od gsal gti mug rang sangs/ 'pho ba ma bsgoms sangs rgyas/ bar do rgyal ba longs sku'o/ /de la dang po thabs lam bde drod rang 'bar la/ gtum mo nyid kyi sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ spyir khrid kyi dngos gzhi yin kyang*/

gtum mo rang gi dngos gzhi la ltos pa'i sngon 'gro 'gyur bas/ sngon 'gro lus gnad ma'i stong ra zhes bya/ drod shin tu myur bas gtum mo me rgod kyi dmigs pa zhes kyang bya ste/ de la yang skyabs sems sngon du btang nas/ thog ma'i sngon 'gro bla ma'i rnal 'byor cig dgos pas/ rang lha skur sgom pa'am/ re zhig tha mal pa'i nga rgyal gyis kyang rung ste/ spyi bor gdan bzhi rdzogs su bsgoms pa la/ gtum mo'i skabs 'dir sna tshogs padma mi byed/ padma dkar por bsgom/ der bzhugs pa'i bla ma yang sku dngos su sgom na yang sku mdog dkar ba/ 'od zer dkar po 'phro bar bsgom/ rdo rje 'chang du bsgom na yang*/ sku mdog ston zla ltar dkar bas bsgom mod/ chos drug gi skabs thams cad du/ bla ma sku dngos su bsgom pa nyid gtso che ba yin gsung nas phyag len 'debs par mdzad/ lar sku dngos kyi rnam pa la mos sam/ rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa la mos/ gang la mos pa de nyid sku bde ba'i nyams rgyas shing*/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ rang la byin gyis rlob rlob 'dra ba zhig bsgom/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che/ sems can thams cad kyi don du/ bdag gi lus la bde drod kyi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skye bar mdzad du gsol/ sems la bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skye bar mdzad du gsol/ ces gsol ba drag tu btab/ mthar bla ma bdud rtsi'i ngo bor zhu/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs te thim/ rang gi tha mal rnam smin gyi lus ngag yid gsum nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar sang ste dag/ye shes lha'i sku gsung thugs su gyur pa ni/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo/ phyag g.yas rdo rje thur du cung zad sdigs pa/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar bsnams pa/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang*/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan/ rlon po lnga bcu'i do shal can pad nyi mi ro mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng na/

zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na gnas pa/ spyan gsum dbu skra grol ba sogs cha byad spyi dang mthun/ gang ltar yang rang rdo rje phag mo ku mdog phyag mtshan rnam pa gang gsal gsal zhig ci nus su gsal btab ste cung zad sems bzung*/ de phyi'i dmigs pa yin/ de nas rang lha skur gsal ba'i lus nang la sems gtad pas/ lus kyi nang sha khrag rus gsum sogs gang yang med pa'i stong sang nge ba/ phyi pags pa'i rnam pa yang shin tu srab pa/ nang khong stong de yang 'od dmar po drod kyi rang bzhin gyis khyab pa/ dpe dar dmar gyi gur ram/ khru ma phus btab pa lta bu zer ba de yin/ skra'i rtsa ba dang ba spu'i rtsa ba tshun chad kyang sbubs stong du sbu gu sag ge bsgom dgos gsung*/ gang ltar na'ang rang lus rdo rje phag mo'i skur gsal ba de'i lus nang stong sang nge ba spyi bo nas zhabs mthil gyi bar dang*/ zhabs mthil nas spyi bo'i bar dang*/ phyag zhabs kyi sor mo'i rtse mo'i bar kun tu rim pas gsal btab cing nang stong sang nge ba la sems gtad/ nang gi dmigs pa'o/ nyams khrid rang byed na/ phyi nang gnyis po 'di la'ang so sor zhag shas bskyangs na shin tu legs/ de nas me rgod kyi dmigs pa dngos ni/ skabs de nas lus gnad me thab drug chings bya ste/ rkang pa gnyis re mig ltar bsnol la tsog pu bya/ rkang ngar g.yas pa nang dang g.yon pa phyi la yod pa byed/ lag pa g.yas g.yon bar lhu g.yas g.yon la bsnol mar 'jus/ gru mo gnyis pus mo'i steng du yod par byas la sgal tshigs bsrang*/ lta stangs sogs lus gnad lhag ma spyi dang 'dra/ de nas thun gyi dang po la rlung ro dal la ring ba lan gsum bus/ rlung sbyor dngos ni/ de rjes steng rlung ran par rngubs te lte 'og tu mnan/ 'og rlung rang gnas su bcing*/ yar 'then pa mi dgos/ dmigs pa ni rang gi lte ba'i thad dang*/ de'i thad kyi rgyab dang*/

mkhal khung g.yas g.yon gnyis te gnas bzhir me'i gong bu dbyibs zlum po/ kha dog dmar ba/ reg bya tsha ba/ me lce lhab lhab 'bar ba rang ma yin pa la/ 'bar tshad tshad pa sol me dar ma bus pa'am/ lcags bsregs kyi gong bu dmar lhang ba lta bu bzhi bsgoms su gsal btab/ rlung 'jam rlung bzung ba'i ngos nas lto ba g.yas su bskor ba gcig dang*/ g.yon du bskor ba gcig byas pas/ me gong bzhi po de drag tu 'thab nas me lcags gtsubs pa lta bu'i me stag dmar skyas lus kyi nang thams cad 'od dmar chem chem khyab pas/ lus tsha 'u ru ru byung bar bsam/ de ltar mi bde ba med med du rlung bzung nas cung zad mi bde ba snyam byed na/ dang por shugs chung ba/ bar du shugs che ba mthar sang ste rlung bus/ rlung thengs gcig go /yang snga ma ltar bzung zhing dmigs pa yang snga ma ltar bsgom/ thun mjug tu dge ba bsngo'o/ /de ltar zhag shas rlung thengs re la dmigs pa dang g.yas g.yon du skor ba tshar re re kho nas sbyangs/ de nas rim pas zhag shas nas g.yas skor g.yon skor re re bsnan/ grangs kyi tha ma grangs la ngais bzung rang med kyang*/ g.yas skor bcu gnyis dang g.yon skor bcu gnyis tsam du longs song tsa na me'i nus pa rnyed par 'gyur ro gsung*/ thun mtshams su yan lag lnga sbyongs re sngon du 'gro bas/ gtsubs shing dang gtsubs stan ma'i 'khrul 'khor ci nus su sbyang ngo*/ /dmigs skor drug pa'o/ /gnyis pa gtum mo'i dngos gzhi la/ gtum mo zas su za ba/ gos su gyon pa/ stan du 'ding ba/ rtar bzhon pa ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/ gtum mo zas su za ba ste/ chos 'di'i lugs kyi gtum mo'i dmigs pa'i gtso bo yin te/ 'di la yang shes rab dang*/ mos pa'i khyad par gyis dmigs pa rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum yod do/ /de la dang por rgyas pa ni/ sngar bzhin skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams sngon du btang*/

rang lhar gsal ba dang lus nang stong ra bca' ba yang sngar bzhin byas te/ de rjes lus gnad rkang pa sems dpa'i skyil krung lhod kyis byas te rgya che bar bcas lag mthil pus mo'i steng du bkab ste lag ngar bsrang*/ lhag ma lus gnas spyi dang 'dra/ thun gyi mgo 'dir rlung ro dgu sprugs su 'bud de/ dang por dal la ring ba gsum/ bar du drag la 'thung ba gsum/ tha mar ro stod gcus shing 'bud pa gsum/ de rnams lag len bltas pas gsal/ de nas rang gi lus la rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi yi ge gnyis dang bcas pa gsal 'debs/ de yang lus kyi g.yas g.yon gang la yang yo ba'i dbus drang thad/ mdun rgyab kyi dbang du byas na rgyab phyogs la cung zad nye bar/ rtsa dbu ma a wa dhu dhi chos bzhi ldan du gsal 'debs de yang chu shing gi sdong po ltar drang ba ste/ ya yo khyar khyor khyag khyog med pa/ til gyi mar me ltar gsal ba ste rang 'od 'phro ba/ rgya skyegs kyi khu ba ltar dmar ba ste rgya tshos kyis bcos pa'i mdog lta bu/ padma'i snal ma ltar phra ba ste shin tu srab pa'o/ /yongs kyi phyi dbyibs sbom phra ni/ mda' smyug 'bring po tsam ste/ dbu ma de'i yas sna spyi bo tshangs bug la zug ces gsung ste/ de yang dngos su rus pa'i tshangs bug rang ta mi sgom ste/ 'on kyang tshangs bug gi thad spyi gtsug gi yas mtha' nas mar sor gnyis tsam gzhal ba'i sar sleb pa yin/ mas sna lte 'og sor bzhi'i thad du zug par bsgom/ dbu ma de khong stong yas snas sna gnyis ka bcad khar yod cing*/ de'i g.yas su ro ma dmar po dang*/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar po ste gnyis po dbu ma bzhi bshags su btang ba tsam gyi tshad dam/ yang na gro sog tsam yang gsung ste gang ltar bsgoms kyang 'dra/ /de gnyis spyi bo nas lte 'og sor bzhi'i bar dbu ma dang lhan cig tu gsum gshibs ltar yod pa/ yas mas kyi sne ni ro rkyang gnyis ring ba las/

'og tu ro rkyang gnyis dbu ma las sor bzhi tsam gyi ring ba'i ro rkyang gi sne de gnyis yar slog ste/ dbu ma'i mas sna'i nang du chug tsam byas la/ yas sna gnyis po dbu ma'i yas sna'i rgyab phyogs mtheb sor tsam gyi thad du song*/ de mtshams nas gnyis gshibs su byas pa dbu ma'i yas sna'i steng nas bkab cing*/ de nas mdun du 'khyogs te/ ro ma'i sne sna bug g.yas dang*/ rkyang ma'i sne bug g.yon du zug pa'o/ /de ltar ro rkyang dbu ma gsum po gsum gshibs su yod pa las/ lte ba'i thad dang*/ snying ga'i thad dang*/ mgrin pa'i sbom sa'i thad dang*/ spyi bo'i dbu ma'i yas sna nas mar rtse sor gnyis tsam gzhal ba'i thad de bzhi po de rnams rtsa 'khor gyi lte ba zlum po a long khong seng can lta bu/ ro rkyang dbu ma gsum dbus kyi srog shing 'dra ba la/ des sked dkris byas pa lta bu ste/ de lta bu'i lte ba las rtsa 'dab rnams rtsa sbubs can gyi rnam pa gdugs kyi rtsibs ma bzhin du skyes par gyur pa las/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu re bzhi gdugs rtsibs ma can gan rkyal du bzhag pa lta bu/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad gdugs rtsibs ma can nyid lta bu/ mgrin par longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug gdugs 'degs lta bu/ spyi bo bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab sum cu so gnyis/ gdugs kyi rtsibs ma lta bu/ 'khor lo bzhi kar phyi rim nang rim gyi dbye ba med/ grangs de rnams mu ded yin/ thams cad kyang kha dog dmar po/ lcags bsregs ltar 'od dmar lham me ba bsgom/ rtsa dbu ma'i nang gi yas sna'i phyogs su haṃ yig dkar po mgo bo thur du lta ba/ thig le'i rang bzhin nyams bde zhing bsil ba zhu la khad khad pa bsgom/ /dbu ma'i mas sne'i nang rtsa gsum 'dus mdor/ /raṃ yig dmar po mgo bo gyen du lta ba/ / me'i rang bzhin shin tu tsha ba/

dbu ma'i mas sna nas sor bzhi gzhal ba tsam gyi thad bshang sgo'i phyogs su rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam sngon po g.yo ba'i rang bzhin gdan thabs su yod pa/ bcad kha mdun la bstan pa rnams sgom mo/ /dmigs pa'i gzhi de lta gsal thebs nas/ yang rlung ro zhig dal bus bsal/ de nas steng rlung shar te rngubs pa lte 'og tu bskyur stabs su mnan/ de dang mnyam du 'og rlung bskum ste/ lte bar kha sbyor du bzung*/ cung zad mi bde ba snyam byed na gzhil bar bya ste/ de yang sngar rlung bzung ba de nyid cung zad kyang phyir ma btang par slar yang rngubs chung gang nus bya ste/ lte ba'i gnas su g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du 'then gnon byas nas kyang gang thub bzung*/ yang mi bde ba snyam byed na/ dang por shugs chung ba/ bar du shugs che ba/ mthar sang gis btang ba rnams la bslab/ de ma thag tu yang rngubs te sngar bzhin bsgom/ ma goms gong du ngal na rlung thengs bzhi'i mtshams sam/ brgyad dang*/ bcu gnyis sam/ bcu drug gam/ nyi shu'am/ nyer bzhi'am/ nyer brgyad dam/ so gnyis kyi mtshams su ngal gso yi/ gang 'dod du bzhag tu mi rung ngo*/ /dmigs pa ni/ rlung rnams sna sgo nas zhugs/ ro rkyang gi lam brgyud de/ lte 'og rtsa gsum 'dus mdor sleb/ 'og rlung bskums pas bshang sgo'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor las rlung po kha mdog sngon po shin tu phra ba zhig mdung tshugs su langs te dbu ma'i mas snar chud/ de ltar ro rkyang dang thur sel gyi rlung gsum po/ gcig tu 'dus pas raṃ yig la bus pas/ raṃ yig las gtum mo ye shes kyi me lhag ste 'bar/ mar me 'bar ba lta bu de'i rtse mo shin tu phra zhing rno ba spu shad dmar po lta bu/ phra ba/ gsal ba/ 'tsher ba zhig je ring je ring la 'bar/ rlung thengs 'ga' re song ba na/ spyi bo'i haṃ las reg reg 'dug par bsam/ de nas rim pas haṃ zhu ba las byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyun dar dkar po'i snal ma brkyang ba tsam babs/

je ring je ring la lte ba'i raṃ la thim par bsam/ spyir gtum mo la/ me kho na la dmigs pa theg le la dmigs pa/ 'bar 'dzag la dmigs pa gsum yod pa las 'di phyi ma yin/ de la'ang 'bros 'ded dang*/ skra shad 'dzings pa lta bu dang*/ phye dmar khyab pa la sogs pa'i lugs sna tshogs yod kyang*/ 'di bar pa yin/ de yang dbu ma'i dbus su 'bar 'dzag gnyis ka rgyun mi 'chad pa la zer te/ de las kyang dbu ma'i dbus kyi nang gzhir bzhag pa las/ mdun gyi phyogs su me 'bar ba dang*/ rgyab kyi phyogs su byang chub kyi sems 'bab pa bsgom dgos gsung*/ gtum mo 'bar ba'i me 'od gang du slebs pa des lus nang du tsha 'ur gyis byung ba dang*/ byang chub kyi sems 'bab pa'i 'od skya yaṃ byung ba na/ lus thams cad bde cham gyis byung bar mos pa gnyis re mos su yid la bya'o/ /thun mtshams su dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ de ltar na dmigs pa rgyas pa ste/ dmigs skor bdun pa'o/ /dbang rtul la 'di spong sgom du byed na/ rtsa gsum dang 'khor lo bzhi dang yig 'bru dang rlung sbyor dang 'bar 'dzag rnams la thun re re byas na'ang 'ong ba lags/ gtum mo zas su za ba'i dmigs pa 'bring po ni/ rtsa 'khor lo bzhi lte ba sked dkris 'dra ba dang bcas pa'i skor de rnams bor nas/ lhag ma sngar ltar bsgom pa kho na'o/ /dmigs pa bsdus pa ni/ de'i steng du ro rkyang gnyis kyang spangs pa ste/ 'di la mi 'dra ba'i khyad rlung sna sgo nas rngubs pa gnyis dbu ma'i g.yas g.yon nas mar mdung tshugs su song*/ lte 'og nas sor drug gam brgyad tsam du mar sleb pa de/ 'og rlung yar bskum pa'i rlung dang phrad pa na/ de la brdabs pa ltar yang thabs su yar log ste thams cad dbu ma'i mas snar zhugs/ raṃ la bskul bar bsam dgos/ gzhan 'dra/ de ltar na dmigs pa 'bring bsdus gnyis po/ dmigs pa rgyas pa'i nang du chud pa yin pas logs su mi 'dren/

dmigs skor bdun pa nyid du 'dus/ de'i rgyu mtshan rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum kar bla ma las thob par byas nas/ rang gi mos pa dang mthun par gang rung zhig kho na bsgom rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro/ / dmigs skor gcig yin kyang 'chad pa'i tshe chos thun so sor byed pa ni mi 'gal lo/ /'dir mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum gyis mdzad pa sogs khrid yig rnying pa rnams na/ sngon 'gro me'i stong ra la rkang pa skyil krung dang*/ dngos gzhi gtum mo zas za la me thab drug chings byed par bshad na'ang/ bla ma'i zhal la ltos pa'i phyir man ngag dkrugs te bshad pa yin/ lag len gong du bshad pa kho na byed dgos so/ /gtum mo zas su za ba 'di gtum mo'i dngos gzhi yin/ gzhung las/ rang lus thabs ldan rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi/ a haṃ 'bar 'dzag skad cig dga' bzhis brgyan/ /zhes gsungs pa'i bstan don dngos yin no/ / raṃ yig bsgoms pa la lte ba'i a thung sgom pa'i don tshang ba dang*/ /dmigs pa 'bring bsdus gnyis la 'khor lo bzhi dngos su ma bsgoms kyang*/ rtsa dbu ma yongs rdzogs bsgoms pa'i phyir/ /dbu ma nyid 'khor lo bzhi khar gyi lte ba yin pas/ don 'khor lo bzhi char tshang ba yin no/ /gnyis pa gtum mo gos su gon pa ni/ dmigs pa'i rtsa ba gtum mo zas su za ba cung zad goms pa/ zhig gis bya ste/ 'di la phyi'i dmigs pa grang ba yid la mi byed/ gnas khang rdo rje'i rang bzhin nam/ lcags bsregs kyis sa gzhi dang*/ rwa gur la me 'ur 'ur 'bar bar bsgom/ rang lha sku dang*/ rgyan phyag rgya lnga/ na bza' stag lpags mi lpags/ thams cad kyang me lce yal la la 'bar bar bsam/ nang gi dmigs par lte 'og sor bzhir raṃ las 'bar ba'i mes lus nang thams cad gang bar bsam/ lus gnad tsog pu/ lag gnyis pus mo'i phyi nas 'khyud dbugs sha dbrag la 'gro bar byed ces bshad na'ang*/ man ngag gab pa yin pas/ lag gnyis nang du bsnol te/

g.yas kyi lag mthil g.yon gyi mkhal khung dang*/ g.yon gyi lag mthil g.yas kyi mkhal khung la bkab/ phyi nang pus 'khyud kyis bsdoms pa yin/ rlung gi gnad/ gzhil ba lan gnyis re'am/ gsum re lus stobs dang bstun nas bya/ thun mtshams su gtsubs shing gtsubs stan gyi 'khrul 'khor la 'bad/ 'dis drod 'phral du skyed/ lus rngul na gos srab tu btang zhing*/ lus la dril phyis bya'o/ /de yang dngos gzhi zas su za ba ma bsgoms par me'i stong ra yun ring du bsgom pas kyang 'di bsgom du rung ngo*/ /dmigs skor brgyad pa'o/ /gnyis pa stan du 'ding ba ni phyi'i dmigs pa gos su gyon pa dang 'dra ba las/ lhag par gdan lcags bsregs kyi padma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor me lce 'u ru ru 'bar la rang nyid gnas pa lhag por bsgom/ nang gi dmigs pa lte ba'i thad du raṃ dmar po 'od lhag ge ba la sems gtad/ rlung gnad 'jam rlung rgyun chags su bzung*/ nyin par nam stod de ltar byas nas gnyid log khar/ rab skyil krung*/ 'bring tsog pu/ tha ma sngas mtho ru bcug/glo g.yas pa 'og tu bcug/pus brang sbyar/ lus sum ltab tu nyal/ sems lte ba'i raṃ la gtad pa'i ngang nas gnyid du 'gro bar bya/ 'di'i dgos pa ni/ gtum mo bsgoms pas gnyid kyi 'od gsal zin pa dang*/ nyin par bsgoms pa'i drod kyi rgyun de mtshan mo mi yal ba'i phyir yin/ 'di yang me'i stong ra'am/ zas su za ba gang rung zhig cung zad 'byongs pas bsgom na don ston par the tshom med pa yin no/ / dmigs skor dgu pa'o/ /bzhi pa rlung ltar bzhon pa ni/ rtsa ba'i dmigs pa dang rlung 'byongs pa zhig gis yun ring du bsgoms na/ rta mchog dang mnyam pa'i 'gros 'byung ngo zhes pa lta bu rtags dang yon tan gyi tshul du 'byung ba yin/ da lta lag tu longs nges la zla ba gcig gnyis tsam rlung sbyangs pa'i las dang po pas sgom na/ lam gyi 'gro 'dug gis rtsa rlung 'khrugs pa dang*/

khams rnyog par mi 'gyur zhing*/ 'gro 'dug nyid lus sbyongs su 'gro ba'i phan yon yod do/ /de yang lam du 'jug pa'i sngon du khug pa nyer gcig tsam bzung*/ de skabs dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa'am/ yang na mi rtog pa rkyang pa bsgoms kyang btub/ dngos ni lam du 'gro ba'i tshe/ lag pa stod skyil bcas/ rlung 'jam rlung bzung*/ dmigs pa ni rlung gi lha mo dkar ljang gshog pa can gnyis kyis mchan khung nas btegs te/ gang 'dod pa'i gnas su phyin par bsam gsung*/ 'dir rlung khug pa zhes pa ni/ gong du bshad pa'i rlung thengs bzhi bzhi pa de la zer ba yin/ de nyer gcig la rlung thengs brgyad cu gya bzhi yod/ de yang las dang po bum can ma 'grub pa rnams kyi dbang du byas par 'dug/yun ring bzung nus pa rnams la grangs de tsam mi dgos/ khrid yig rnams na mi gsal yang skabs der bar lhu 'jus pa'i stod skyil tsam pos mi chog/khu tshur mchan khung du bcug pa'i stod skyil bcas nas/ rlung gi lha mos btegs pa sgom dgos zhes/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma gsung

ngo*/ /dmigs skor bcu pa'o/ /gsum pa rjes kyi khrid la/ srid pa'i dbang zhu ba dang*/ gegs rang grol gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ man ngag 'di thob phyin chad nas/ gtum mo bsgoms pa'i mjug thun mtshams la 'jug khar 'di tshar gcig nges par bsgom dgos te/ de yang rang gi spyi bor seng khri pad dkar nyi zla'i gdan la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma sku dngos sam/ rdo rje 'chang gang du bsgoms kyang rung mod kyi/ rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid bsgom pa zab par bzhed/ gang ltar yang sku mdog dkar la 'od zer 'phro ba/ de nyid skyabs gnas kun 'dus su shes/ mchod yon dang*/ me tog la sogs pa'i nyer spyod dang*/ khang bzang bzhugs khri/ na bza' rin po che'i gter dang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing dang*/ 'dod 'jo'i ba dang*/ rgyal srid sna bdun dang*/ bkra shis lha mo brgyad la sogs pa/ mdor na phyogs dus kun gyi mchod pa bzang dgu thams cad 'bul ba ni/ /phyi'i mchod pa'o/ /de nas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa'i dam rdzas rnams ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs te 'bul ba ni nang gi mchod pa'o/ /bde ba skyed byed rigs kyi/ yum 'bul ba ni gsang ba'i mchod pa'o/ /de thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam ltar shes pa ni/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'o/ /de ltar mchod pa bzhi rdzogs su phul nas/ 'di skad ces/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che la/ phyi me tog bdug spos/ nang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ gsang ba bde stong gi ye shes/ yang gsang de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa dam pa rnams 'bul lo/ /bzhes nas bdag la dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol/ ces gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ bla ma'i sku las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar la dwangs pa nyams bde ba dang ldan pa drag tu babs/ spyi bo nas zhugs/ smin mtshams yan chad gang*/ bum dbang thob/ sku'i dngos grub stsal/ yang bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis mgrin pa yan chad gang*/

gsang dbang thob/ gsung gi dngos grub stsal/ yang snying ga yan cha gang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs kyi dngos grub stsal/ yang bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun lte ba sogs nas brgyud/ rkang mthil yan chad lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thams cad stsal/ bla ma nyid kyang 'od du ltem ste zhu nas rang la thim/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang*/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med gcig tu gyur pa la mnyam par bzhag /de rjes dge ba bsngos nas thun mtshams la 'jug pa yin/ dmigs pa 'di bla ma la ma thob gong du der zad/ thob phyin chad gdams ngag 'di'i lugs kyi gtum mo'i dmigs pa'i rigs bsgom pa thams cad la/ thun gyi 'jug tu 'di tshar re nges pa bsgom dgos pas/ gtum mo'i dmigs pa'i rjes chog lta bur 'gyur ba'i phyir/ rjes kyi khrid du bsdus pa yin la/ spyir 'di nyid dmigs pa gzhan dang ma sbrel bar logs su bsgom pa'i srol yang yod cing*/ bla ma'i sku las dbang bzhi len pa'i gnad don thams cad tshang zhing*/ spros pa'i bsre bslad med pas/ byin rlabs kyi tshan kha shin tu che'o/ /skabs 'gar zhag gsum mam/ lnga'am/ bdun sogs 'di kho na la dril te bsgoms na/ sgom gang la yang bogs bla na med par phyin par 'gyur ro/ /gtum mo'i mjug tu nges par bsgom dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ gtum mo dngos gzhi bsgoms pa'i bde drod kyi nyams myong brtan par byed pa dang*/ rlung stod du 'tshangs pa thur du 'bebs pa dang*/ rtsol ba drag pos lus zungs la gnod pa'i rigs la/ 'dis lus zungs gso ba ting nge 'dzin gyi bcud len du 'gyur ba dang*/ thun mtshams su grib sogs bar chad srung ba dang*/ gtso bor byin rlabs brtan pa'i sgo nas ye shes skyed pa'o/ /dmigs skor bcu gcig pa'o/ /gnyis pa gegs rang grol ni/ spyir gegs sel rgyas pa gzhan du shes dgos kyang*/

khrid kyi dkyus la 'di tsam 'byung ste/ gtum mo bsgom pa phal cher la rlung stod du 'tshang ba dang*/ 'og tu kunda'i gegs 'byung ba yin/ de yang 'ga' zhig la gnyis kar 'byung ba'ang yod/ phal cher la gang rung re 'byung ba shas che/ gegs kyi rnam pa gzhan rnams ni re re tsam ma gtogs 'byung ba dkon no/ /de la stod gegs bsal ba ni/ thabs lam gtum mo bsgom pa'i skabs su ro stod na ba dang*/ mgo la zur gzer skye ba dang*/ shes pa 'phyo ba sogs byung na/ sngon 'gro nyams su blangs pa'i rjes su/ rang lus stong sang nge ba gsal btab ste/ rlung thengs gcig gnyis shig sngon du btang*/ gang na sar bu ga zlum po sum tshom nor bu mig gsum 'dra ba gsal btab/ lag gnyis khu tshur mdun du brkyangs te/ slar khu tshur gyi rgyab nu steng dang*/ lag ngar rtsibs logs la thebs par byed pa dang mnyam por kha nas ha thung drag tu 'don/ nad rnams bu ga nas dud pa'am rlung tshubs kyi rnam pas phyur phyur phyir rgyang ring du 'gro ba dang*/ lus kyi nang stong sang sang song bar mos/ lus thams cad na na sus khrol tshags lta bur sgom pa khyad par yin/ lus kyi cha shas 'di rang na ba'i nges gzung med par shes pa 'phyo ba sogs byung na snying rlung gi byed las yin pas/ snying dkar nag gi mtshams su bu ga sgom na legs gsung ngo*/ /dmigs skor bcu gnyis pa'o/ /smad kun da'i gegs bsal ba ni/ rab dgag sgrub dang bral ba'i blos sel/ 'bring dbang bskur dang tshogs 'khor gyis sel/ tha ma dmigs pa dang 'khrul 'khor gyis sel gsung*/ yang chags sred dang bag chags kyi rgyu las byung ba yin na/ dgag sgrub dang bral bas sel/ grib dang dam sel yin na/ dbang bskur dang tshogs kyi 'khor gyis sel/ gang 'dzag dang nad gzhi yin na/ dmigs pa dang 'khrul 'khor gyis sel yang gsung ngo*/ /'dir 'dzag bsrung bka' rgya ma'i dmigs pa sbyor rgyu yin na'ang/

bka' rgya ma yin pa'i phyir mang po'i tshogs pa'i nang du mi 'chad pa'i zur tsam smos pa de kas chog/de la thun gcig byed dam mi byed blo dang sbyar ro/ /yang slob ma gal che nyung ngu la dmigs pa de 'bogs nas/ de nyid dmigs skor bcu gsum par 'gyur ba yang shes par bya'o/ /yang dkyus ltar na/ gtum mo la gzhung tshig gi zin pa'i dmigs pa bdun yod/ rtsa tshig gis dngos su ma zin kyang gtum mo'i thon chos sam/ bde drod kyi bogs 'don khyad par can byin rlabs bla ma'i gtum mo 'di yin/ ces mtshams sbyar nas/ byin rlabs bla ma'i gtum mo/ skabs 'dir ston te/ de'i dmigs pa yang logs su shes par bya'o/ / de ltar na de rnams kyis ni rang lus thabs ldan gyi gtum mo rgyas par bstan pa yin la/ 'di'i yan lag tu gtum mo'i gzhung khrid kyi man ngag 'khrul 'khor rnams kyang lag len du 'debs pa shin tu gal che'o/ /gzhan lus shes rab kyi gtum mo'i skor ni man ngag rno la zab pa yod kyang re zhig gleng brjod med par 'jog/mkhas grub gzhon nu grub kyi zhal na re/ dpal ldan shangs pa'i bka' brgyud 'di rgya gar gyi rdo rje gdan pa dang*/ bod yul gyi sangs rgyas glang ri pa'i rnam thar skyong dgos/ gtsang sgom gyi brgyud 'dzin yin/ 'jol nyog gi brgyud 'dzin min gsung ngo*/ /gnyis pa sgyu lus chags sdang rang grol gyi gdams ngag la/ dbang po rab bla ma dam pa grogs su bsten pa/ dbang po 'bring tshig gzhan gyis bar ma mchod par khrid pa/ dbang po tha ma mal gcig tu ting nge 'dzin bskyed pa'o/ / dang po la/ mos gus bla ma'i lam khyer dang*/ cir snang bden med lam khyer gnyis so/ /dang po mos gus bla ma'i lam khyer ni/ dbang po rab kyi skabs 'dir sgyu lus kyi dmigs pa'i rkang chen gcig tu yang byed la/ spyir sgyu lus la sogs pa chos lnga po thams cad kyi dmigs pa'i gzhi ma yang 'di yin no/

/de yang 'di ltar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nges par sngon du btang*/ dag byed stong ra sgom mi sgom nyams dang sbyar/ de nas rang gzhan thams cad la gzhig 'grel zhig bcug ste/ ga re/ lar 'dus byas thams cad la rtag pa'i go skabs med/ sgos su 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can thams cad 'chi ba las ma 'das/ de yang myur 'chi dang nam 'chi cha med/ 'chi ba la dam pa'i chos ma yin pa cis kyang mi phan/ de phyin chad da ni zas gos longs spyod kha drag dbang thang gtam snyan mi snyan dgra 'dul gnyen skyong sogs gang gis kyang dgos pa mi 'dug/cis kyang phan pa mi 'dug/da phyin chad gang dga' ci dgar thong snyam pa dang*/ nam 'chi cha med dang*/ cis kyang dgos med kyi 'dun pa dung dung ba sbyangs/ de ka la cung zad ngal gso/ de nas rang skad cig gis yi dam lha gsal 'debs te/ de yang ni gu'i chos drug 'di rgyud sde thams cad kyi dgongs pa yin pas lhag pa'i lha gong du bsgoms kyang rung ba yin/ de'i nang nas kyang rgyud sde lnga'i don gyis bcud bsdus pa yin pas rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gang blo la 'thad pa cig tu bsgoms kyang legs mod/ mnyam med rin chen brtson 'grus man chad brgyud pa nas brgyud pa'i phyag len du/ bde mchog lhan skyes nyid du bsgom par mdzad pa nyid byin rlabs kyi rgyun dang ldan pa'i rim pa yin pas/ rang nyid skad cig gis 'khor lo bde mchog lhan skyes sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po dang*/ g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan dmar mo mnan pa/ stags lpags kyi smad dkris/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan/ thod rlon gyi do shal/ rus pa'i rgyan drug/thor tshugs la zla ba phyed pa dang sna tshogs rdo rje la sogs pas brgyan pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/

me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsgom/ de yang dang por bsgrims te gsal btab/ de nas lha sku snang stong tsam sgyu ma lta bu de la cung zad sems gtad de rig pa khong lhod kyis bzhag/de ma thag tu bla ma bsgom ste/ de yang rang gi rigs bdag gi tshul du spyi bo nyid du bsgom pa thob thang yin/ 'on kyang rnam pa mi bde na rang gi spyi bo'i steng gi nam mkha' drang thad la bsgom/ de yang rnam pa mi dod na mdun gyi phyogs steng gi nam mkha' la zhal tshur bstan pa bsgoms kyang rung ste/ gang ltar na'ang seng khri sna tshogs padma nyi zla rnams brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma sku bkrag mdangs gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par bsgoms te/ sgyu lus la sogs pa'i chos phyi ma lnga po rnams kyi skabs/ rdo rje 'chang du sgom na/ sku mdog sngon por byed/ 'on kyang lag len bla ma sku dngos nyid sgom par mdzad pa de ka gtso che'o/ /de nas dmigs pa spros pa'i dbang du byas nas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad spyan drangs te rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ bla ma kun 'dus su gyur/ de bzhin du yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams thams cad spyan drangs thim yi dam kun 'dus su gyur/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs th-im sangs rgyas kun 'dus su gyur/ lung rtogs kyi dam chos rnams yi ge'i gzugs kyi rnam par spyan drangs thim chos kun 'dus su gyur/ theg pa che chung gi 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad spyan drangs thim dge 'dun kun 'dus su gyur/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma thams cad spyan drangs te rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku la bstim chos skyong kun 'dus su gyur/ de ltar na rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid bla ma kun 'dus/ yi dam/ sangs rgyas chos/ dge 'dun/ chos skyong kun 'dus mtshan thos pa tsam gyis 'khor ba ngan song thams cad las sgrol bar mdzad na/

gsol ba btab na lta smos kyang ci dgos snyam pa dang*/ gzhan yang sgo du ma nas mos gus drag tu bsgom/ de nas gsol ba 'debs dgos te/ rang gi tshe 'di'i dngos kyi pha ma dang*/ rang la gnod par byed pa'i dgra dang gdon bgegs rang nyid gang du gnas pa'i gzhi bdag rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can thams cad kyang gnas 'di nyid du 'dus te/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa la lus gus pas phyag dang bskor ba byed/ ngag gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ yid gus pas mos gus rtse gcig tu byed par bsam/ de nas rang gis gsol 'debs ngag tu gyer ba na 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can thams cad kyis kyang ram bu btegs pa'i tshul gyis ku di ri ri gsol ba 'debs par bsam zhing*/ ngag tu/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che/ sems can thams cad kyi don du/ bdag gis bdag 'dzin blos thongs par mdzad du gsol/ dgos med rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ sgyu lus 'byongs par mdzad du gsol/ rmi lam 'byongs par mdzad du gsol/ 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub da lta nyid du myur ba nyid du 'dug sa 'di nyid du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces mos gus drag po phar la thim phod dang*/ tshur la sim phod kyi tshul gyis gsol ba 'debs/ dmigs pa rgya chen 'byung*/ bzhi pa rdo ri brag rtsi shing nags tshal snod bcud thams cad las gsol 'debs kyi sgra 'u ru ru 'byung bar bsam mo gsung*/ de ltar na/ mos gus gsol 'debs kho nas thun gyi dngos gzhi bskyangs te/ thun 'jog khar bla ma 'od du ldem ste zhu/ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ de ka'i ngang la sems dus gsum gyi rnam rtog spangs nas lhod de bzhag/thun mtshams su 'dun pa gsum dang*/ ldan par bya bar bshad pa ltar ram/ yang na dbang por rab kyi skabs 'dir/ thun mtshams su yang 'dun pa gzhan gnyis do gal chung*/

bla ma'i mos gus rang dgos pa yin ces zhal nas gsung ba ltar/ re zhig spros pa gzhan spangs te mos gus kho na bsgom par bya'o/ /dmigs skor bcu gsum pa'o/ /gnyis pa cir snang bden med lam khyer ni/ dmigs pa snga ma de bsgoms pas ji zhig nas/ snang ba thams cad bden med bkrag med du bun long ba/ da lta'i mtho dman bzang ngan nye ring bden bden po 'di thams cad g.yas med du shig gis 'gro ba zhig 'byung*/ de yang blos phar la bden med du bsgoms pa'i shugs tsam ma yin par mos gus kyi stobs kyis khong nas rang shar du 'byung ba yin/ de ltar byung na skabs der sgyu ma lta bu'i nyams shar ba zhes bya ba yin pas/ de nyid du rang gzhan snod bcud snang ba thams cad la sems gtad nas/ ga re 'di thams cad snang ni snang*/ bden ni mi bden/ sgyu ma lta bu yin/ rmi lam lta bu yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa shugs cher bskyed/ de rjes sgyu ma lta bu'o bden par med do snyam pa'i blo de ka'i rang ngo la che re bltas pas/ gang yang gzung du med pa zhig yong*/ de la lhod de mnyam par bzhag/gang shar de la bcas bcos mi bya'o/ /'di la nyams len gyi ngo bor sngar gyi mos gus bla ma'i lam khyer de ka'i ngang nas/ sgyu ma'i 'dun pa zhig lhag por snon pa ka yin/ res bla ma 'od du zhu rang la bstim nas/ sgyu ma'i 'dun pa bsgom/ res bla ma mdun nam spyi bor bzhugs bzhin pa'i ngang nas sgyu ma'i 'dun pa bsgom pa gnyis po gang 'os 'os su bya/ dmigs skor bcu bzhi pa'o/ /de lta bu nyams su blangs kyang 'phral du dge sbyor ma skyes na/ mos gus rab kyi tshad du phyin pa ma byung bas lan/ dbang po rab tu ma chung*/ da gnyis pa dbang po 'bring tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod par khrid pa la rang lus snang stong lha sku sgom pa dang*/ cir snang sgyu ma'i lam khyer gnyis yod/ dang po ni/ skyabs 'gro nas bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa'i bar du dbang po rab kyi skabs ltar nyams su blangs/

thun gyi phyed tsam sum gnyis tsam bla ma'i gsol 'debs bya/ de nas bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la bstim/ bla ma dang rang sems dbyer med la cung zad mnyam par bzhag/der rnam rtog cig thol gyis skye tshad pa na/ rang gi lus sems la cher gyi bltas nas/ rang nyid lha skur gsal btab/ de la gzhig 'grel zhig btang ste/ ga re/ lha skur snang ba 'di yang rang gi sems kyi snang ba las gzhan phyi rol tu grub pa cung zad tsam yang med/ lha sku 'di kho na sems yin/ sems kho na lha sku 'dir snang ba yin snyam du 'dun pa drag tu sbyong ba 'di gnad gcig yin/ yang sems kyi ngo bor yang bden dngos su ma grub snang ba tsam ma gtogs phyi nang bar gsum gang na yang mi 'dug/ngo ti 'di 'dra zhig yin bya ba gcig kyang mi gda'/ /snang ni snang*/ bden ni mi bden/ sgyu ma lta bu'o/ /zhes 'dun pa drag tu sbyong ba 'di gnad gnyis pa yin/ de nas sgyu ma lta bu'o snyam mkhan khong gi ngo bo la bltas pas 'dun pa de yang rang sar zhi/ gang shar ngos bzung med pa la che re 'jog pa 'di gnad gsum pa'o/ /de ltar na gnad gsum dang ldan pa'i 'dun pa de nyid yang yang bsgom dgos/ dmigs skor bco lnga pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gnad gsum po de dag snang ba gzhan thams cad la rim gyi spo zhing sbyong ba yin te/ de yang rang lus snang stong lha sku'i dmigs pa de thog mar bsgoms nas/ de ma yal ba'i ngang nas thog mar rang gi gnas khang dang rdzas longs spyod thams cad la/ sems kyi snang ba las gzhan du med pa dang*/ sems de yang sgyu ma lta bu dang*/ sgyu mar 'dzin pa yang dbyings su yal ba'i rig pa rang shar gyi rang 'gros skyong ba la bslab/ de la goms nas rang dbang ba'i zas nor 'khor g.yog yul zhing sogs yod na de dag dang*/ chags sdang skye ba'i yul dgra gnyen la nges par sbyang*/ de la goms nas rim gyis snang ba thams cad la gnad gsum po de sbyar ro/

/thun mtshams thams cad du 'chi ba mi rtag pa'i 'dun pa dang*/ bla ma'i mos gus dang*/ snang ba gang shar bden med sgyu ma lta bur bsgom pa ste/ gsum po gang rung gcig dang ma bral bar bya'o/ /'di la 'dun pa gsum sbrags zer ro/ /de ltar na dmigs skor bcu drug pa'o/ /gsum pa dbang po tha ma mal gcig tu ting nge 'dzin skyed pa la/ sad pa bzhi dang bral ba cig dgos/ bzhi ni 'gro 'dug mang po dge sbyor gyi sad/ 'pho bskyas mang po dge sbyor gyi sad/ blo sna mang po dge sbyor gyi sad/ long gtam mang po dge sbyor gyi sad/ de rnams spangs te bsgom dgos/ de la dbye na/ 'gro drug sgyu mar 'char byed/ nad gdon sgyu ma lam khyer/ 'char byed yon tan tshogs drug/zhen med sgyu ma rang shar ro/ /dang po 'gro drug sgyu mar 'char byed ni/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bla ma la gsol 'debs kyi bar gong dang 'dra ba las/ thun gyi sum cha tsam thub pa byed gsung*/ de yang thems yig gi dngos bstan ltar na/ sgyu lus dbang po rab 'bring gnyis la gsol 'debs lnga/ dbang po tha ma la gsol 'debs bzhi zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni/ rab 'bring gnyis las sgyu lus 'byongs par mdzad du gsol/ /rmi lam 'byor par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes so sor dbye ba dang*/ tha ma'i skabs su/ sgyu lus rmi lam 'byongs par mdzad du gsol zhing gcig tu bsdoms pas gsol 'debs bzhir gyur ba'i don yin kyang phyag len dang zhal gyi rgyun la/ dbang po rab 'bring tha ma gsum la de lta bu'i dbye ba mi dgos te/ gsum kha la gsol 'debs lnga byed pa dang*/ bzhi byed pa la khyad med gsung*/ de nas bla ma rang la thim pa'i rjes su rang gi lus lha sku'i rnam pa nang stong sang nge ba'i smad kyi cha la sems gtad pas/ der chos 'byung gru gsum kha dog dkar zhing gsal ba/ rtsa ba phra ba thur bstan de bshang sgo'i thad tsam nas mar la zug pa/

gdengs ka che ba gyen du bstan pa'i zur mdun ma de lte ba'i thad dang*/ zur gzhan gnyis mkhal khung g.yas g.yon gyi phyogs su bstan pa/ /dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can gcig bsam/ de la sems gtad pas de'i nang du 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can rnam pa sna tshogs pa rnams lus longs spyod/ mdog/ dbyibs cha lugs cha byad rnams spyi tshul tha dad pa/ rang rang gi bde sdug myong tshul sna tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi chos 'byung gi nang khrig mer gyis gang bar bsam/ de yang rab rgyud la 'gro ba tha dad du skye ba len pa'i rgyu las nyon gyi bag chags thams cad rigs drug so so'i gzugs su shar ba yin snyam pa dang*/ lte 'og na rigs drug gi snang ba 'char ba'i rtsa yig yod pa rnams gzugs brnyan de dang der shar ba yin snyam pa'i mos pa yang cung zad bya/ de rjes de rnams nyid rigs drug dngos yin pa'i tshul du mos pa las/ sems kyi rtsi kha lte ba'i rigs drug la gtad cing*/ /spyir mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad dmigs yul du byas nas ga re 'di rnams snang ni snang*/ bden ni mi bden/ zhes bden med kyi bden med kyi 'dun pa drag tu sbyang*/ yang 'di rnams bden med la bden par gzung bas 'khor bar 'khyam pa snying re rje snyam snying rje brtse lhag pa bsgom/ yang 'di rnams 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las bla mas bskyab tu gsol/ pha bla ma mkhyen snyam pa/ bla ma'i mos gus kyi gdung shugs dang 'brel bar gsol ba zhig kyang btab bo/ /de nas de rnams la sems cher gtad pa na/ rigs drug gi sems can de dag gcig yal gnyis yal/ re re nas rim pas yal te/ mthar chos 'byung gi nang stong sang song ba la sems gtad/ de rjes nas lus dang chos 'byung la yal ba sogs kyi dmigs pa'i spro pa'ang mi dgos te/ gtad so thams cad dang bral ba'i 'dzin med la shig gi bzhag

/yang de la ma gnas na rang gzhan snod bcud thams cad la dmigs te sgyu ma lta bu'o/ /med bzhin du snang ba'o/ /snang bzhin du ma grub pa'o shes par bya/ des dmigs pa tshar gcig song*/ de nyid yang yang bsgom pa'o/ /'di la dmigs pa gtad so'i gnad brgyad yod de/ chos 'byung la dmigs pa/ rigs drug la dmigs pa/ 'gro drug bden med du sbyang ba/ snying rje bskyed pa bla ma'i gsol 'debs/ rigs drug stong par sbyong ba/ rang babs skyong ba/ snang srid sgyu ma'i 'dun pa'o/ /lar dmigs pa zhig la 'di bas zab pa med ces gsung*/ thun mtshams kyi nyams len ni 'di la'ang 'dun pa sum sbrags kho na ste/ de yang dang po nyid nas 'dun pa gsum po gang rung cig sleb par bya snyam pa tsam gyi gar yang mi rung bas/ thog mar gang yang rung ba zhig thun mtshams su sleb pa'i thabs la 'bad/ tshul des gsum kha la re re bzhin du bslabs nas/ mthar gsum po gang rung re dang ma bral bar bya snyam pa'i 'dun pa btang na/ gang rung re dang ma bral bar yong ba yin/ dper na/ thog mar thun mtshams su 'chi ba mi rtag pa'i 'dun pa rtag tu sleb par bya snyam pa'i go cha gyon nas/ thun mtshams su mi rtag pa gang dran thub thub bya/ tshul de lta bus thun mtshams su dran pa'i bya ra bas gzhur na zla ba gcig gam gnyis tsam na thun mtshams phal cher du mi rtag pa'i 'dun pas sleb 'ong*/ de byung na re zhig de bor nas tshul de kas bla ma'i mos gus la bslab/ de yang byung ba na/ yang re zhig de gnyis ka bor nas sgyu ma'i 'dun pa la tshul de kas bslab/ de yang thun mtshams phal cher du byung na/ de rjes gsum po ga rung zhig dang ma bral ba'i 'dun pa tsam btang bas/ gsum po gang rung re dang ma bral bar yong ba yin no/ /dmigs skor bcu bdun pa'o/ /gnyis pa nad gdon sgyu ma lam khyer la/ khrid yig gsum dang zur 'debs rnying pa rnams na/ don 'dra yang rnam grangs nges med la don tshang ma tshang yang ci rigs 'dug na'ang ngais tig can 'di yin te/

nad lam du khyer na/ na bar snang ba 'di yang*/ las ngan sdig sgrib sbyong ba dang*/ dge sbyor gyi bskul ma yin pas mtshan ldan bla ma'i thugs rje'i 'jug pa yin/ sku drin re che snyam pa byas nas/ nad bla ma'i rang bzhin du mos/ gsol ba drag tu btab/ mthar bla ma dang nad dang*/ rang sems gsum dbyer med du che re mnyam par bzhag/ lugs gcig go /yang na bar snang ba 'di 'khrul ba yin gnas tshul lan pa dang na mkhan yod ma myong*/ med bzhin du na bar snang ba rmi lam du na ba dang 'dra snyam/ na ba'i thog de khar sgyu ma rmi lam gyi dran 'dun drag tu bya/ mthar na bar snang bar rang sems su shes/ de la'ang gtad so med pa sgyu ma lta bu la mnyam par bzhag/lugs gnyis pa yin yang na bar snang ba 'di sgyu ma lta bu med bzhin du snang ba yin/ snang ba 'di blos gang byas yin snyam pas steng rlung drag tu mnan/ lte ba'i chos 'byung gi nang nas mar nad rnams song*/ chos 'byung gi gsham je ring je ring la sa 'og thag ring por song zhing*/ nad kyang de'i nang nas mar song ba/ gnyis kar 'og tu 'ja' ltar yal bsam/ lugs gsum pa ste 'di sngon chad zhal shes yin/ de ltar nad lam khyer gsum mo/ /gdon lam khyer la yang gsum ste/ gdon gyi gnod pa dge sbyor gyi bskul mar shes nas/ bla ma'i thugs rje yin pa dang*/ bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ bla ma dang*/ gnod byed dang*/ rang sems gsum po rang bzhin gsal stong du ro mnyam pa'i ngang bskyang ngo*/ /yang na gnod par byed pa po'i 'dre gdod yang med bzhin du snang*/ snang bzhin du ma grub/ de bzhin du gnod pa'i bya ba nyer 'tshe sdug bsngal dang*/ gnod pa 'byung ba'i yul rang nyid lta bu sems can de yang med bzhin du snang*/ snang bzhin du ma grub/ sgyu ma lta bu yin/ rmi lam lta bu yin/ 'di la bden par 'dzin pa re 'khrul snyam du 'dun pa drag tu sbyangs pa'i mthar/ gnod byed du snang ba ngam ngam pa de ka'i ngo bo bltas te cher 'jog

go /yang na chos 'byung dang 'gro ba drug sogs gong bzhin bsgoms la/ gnod byed du snang ba de mdun du dmigs/ sgyu ma lta bu'i 'dun pa'i rtsis zin pa'i ngang nas/ rlung nang du 'jug pa dang lhan cig gdon de yang sna sgo nas bcug stai/ lte ba'i chos 'byung gi nang du sleb/ chos 'byung shin tu yangs por song*/ rlung bzung ste dkrugs 'khor byas pas/ chos 'byung gi kha 'ubs kyis 'dus pas 'bros sa med/ gnod byed de yang rigs drug gi gnas thams cad du 'khyams pas/ so so'i sdug bsngal mthong zhing myong*/ las 'bras la yid ches/ gnod sems zhi/ byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par bsam/ slar yang rlung phyir bsal ba na/ gnod byed de sna sgo nas rgyangs te thon/ thag je ring je ring la yal bar bsam pa'am/ yang na lan chags sel ba'i gtor ma byin te gshegs su gsol/ 'di la nang sel dmigs pa drug yod kyang*/ dmigs chen gcig tu brtsi ba'am gnyis su brtsi'ang yod/ 'dir gcig tu bsdoms te/ dmigs skor bco brgyad pa'o/ /gsum pa 'char byed yod tan tshogs drug ni/ sgyu lus dbang po tha ma'i dmigs pa bsgoms pa'i gnas skabs kyi phan yon bshad pa ste/ 'di la dmigs pa logs pa med/ de yang drod skye ba dang gcig/thig le brtan pa dang gnyis/ rmi lam sbyong spel dang gsum/ 'gro drug gi yul snang dang bzhi sems can smin grol dang lnga/ sgyu ma rang shar dang drug go /dang po ni/ lte ba dang dbu ma'i mas sna gtum mo'i rtsa yig yod sa'i gnas la gnad du bsnun pa yin pas drod rang shugs la skye'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dbu ma'i mas snar sems gtad pas song bas/ rlung yang der 'gag/des rtsa kha sdom/ thig le zin cing brtan par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa ni/ /dbu ma'i mas sna rtsa mdud gru gsum gyi nang du rigs drug gi rtsa yig yod pas/ de la gnad du bsnun par song ba'i phyir/ rmi lam du yang rigs drug gi gzugs brnyan dang*/

yul phyogs sna tshogs pa'i rnam pa can gyi sbyong spel sprul bsgyur dus gcig tu 'byung ngo*/ /bzhi pa ni/ rigs drug gi rtsa khams la rlung sems kyis gnad du bsnun pa yin pas/ rigs drug go gnas lkog gyur rnams mthong ba'i yul snang gtan la 'bebs thub bo/ /lnga pa ni/ mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad la stong nyid snying rje bla ma'i mos gus gsum gyi sgo nas rang gzhan mnyam nyid du bsgoms pa yin pas sems can smin grol nus pa'o/ /drug pa ni/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo ni gnyid sad dus kyi 'khrul ba 'char ba'i gzhi yang yin/ de la gnad du bsnun nas sad dus kyi 'khrul ba dag byed sgyu lus kyi rtogs pa rang shar du 'byung ba'i nus pa yod pa'ang yin pa las de la gnad du bsnun pa yin pas/ sgyu lus kyi rtogs pa zhes bya ba rtog bral gyi lha sku snang ba rab 'byams sgyu ma lta bu rang shar du yong ba'o/ /bzhi pa zhen med sgyu ma rang shar ni/ dbang po tha ma kho na'i khyad chos ma yin te/ spyir sgyu lus kyi rtogs pa tshad du phyin pa'i rtags bshad pa'o/ /de yang sgyu lus bsgoms pas da lta nas chags sdang mtho dman gyi a 'thas 'di je chung du song nas/ mthar bde sdug chags sdang thams cad yul stongs te/ rang gi g.yas nas mi gcig gis bstod pa la dga' ba med/ g.yon nas gcig shos kyis smad pa la mi dga' ba med/ rang ngam rang phyogs la gtam snyan pa dang*/ nom pa sogs thob pa la dga' ba med/ gtam mi snyan pa dang yo byad shor ba la mi dga' ba med pa de'i tshe/ sgyu lus kyi nyams rtogs la brtan pa thob pa yin/ ji skad du/ tsan dan ste'u mtshungs pa la/ /chags bral zhes ni brjod pa yin/ /ces bshad pa lta bu'o/ /phyi ma 'di gnyis la dmigs skor brtsi rgyu med/ chos thun ni gcig gam gnyis ji ltar 'os pa'o/ /gsum pa rmi lam nying 'khrul rang dag gi khrid la/ rmi lam bzung ba/

sbyang ba/ sprul pa bsgyur ba/ yul snang gtan la dbab pa ste drug go /dang po rmi lam bzung ba la/ rang zin thig le dbang bzhi'i gnad kyi gdams pa dang*/ de la ma zin na gnad 'chug med dgu la brten pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'di rmi lam 'dzin pa'i dmigs pa'i rtsa ba gal che shos yin te/ de la bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ dmigs pa spyi khog thams cad sgyu lus kyi skabs dang mtshungs/ khyad par mi 'dra ba ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gis bdag 'dzin blos thongs par mdzad du gsol/ dgos med rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ rmi lam zin par mdzad du gsol/ ces gsol 'debs kyi mtha' bsgyur ba kho na yin/ 'dir ma zad gzhan thams cad la yang 'dra ste/ gsol 'debs kyi tshig dang po gnyis thams cad mtshungs shing*/ tshig rkang gsum pa mtha' bsgyur ba kho na'o/ /de ltar thun gyi sum cha tsam bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgo?ms nas/ bla ma 'od du zhu/ rang la thim/ rang lus lha sku gsal stong du shar ba'i lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma kha dog dkar ba dwangs gsal shel gyi sbubs lta bu/ yar sna spyi bo dang*/ mar sna gsang bar zug pa/ dbu ma'i nang gi yas snar haṃ dkar bo mgo bo thur du blta ba dang*/ mas snar hūṃ dmar po mgo bo gyen du blta ba zhig gsal btab/ gang shar la spyir bden med dang*/ sgos su rmi lam du shes pa'i rtsis bzung nas bsgom pa zhig thams cad du gal che/ spyi bo'i haṃ las thig le dkar po sran ma tsam zhig hril gyis chad/ snying gar sleb/ nyon mongs pa gti mug dag/snying ga yan chad khog stod yang chod pa'am/ bde chod kyis song bar bsam/ gsang ba'i hūṃ las thig le dmar po sran rdog tsam zhig yar chad snying gar sleb/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dag /sked man chad khog smad yang chod pa'am/ bde chos kyi song*/ dkar dmar gnyis po snying gar 'dzom/

zhe sdang ni rang dag la song*/ snying ga'i thad bde sang ba dang*/ yang chod kyis song bar bsam/ de nas dbu ma'i nang snying ga'i thad kyi khong stong der/ thig le gnyis po 'bros 'ded kyi tshul du 'khor ba la sems gtad/ 'khor tshul g.yas skor dang g.yon skor rang gi blo la gang bde yin/ de la sems gtad de/ rmi lam rang yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa'i gsum bzhi zhig bya/ de nas thig le gnyis po gcig rjes gcig gis zin pa'i tshul gyis reg tsam reg tsam 'dug kyang 'khor ba la sems gtad/ rmi lam yin snyam 'dun pa drag tu sbyang*/ de rjes yang sngar bzhin las/ reg pa la brten nas lus sems bde chil chil yong bar mos/ de la'ang sgyu ma'i 'dun pa sbyang*/ de nas dkar po dmar pa la thim dkar po yal ba'am/ de go ldog kyang rung ste/ gang ltar yang gcig la gcig shos thim/ de yang gtad yal du song bar bsam/ de ka'i ngang la ci yang mi bsam par cung zad bzhag/de nas rang gzhan snang ba thams cad la sems gtad de/ 'di thams cad snang ni snang*/ bden ni mi bden snyam pa dang*/ khyad par du yang nga gnyid du song 'dug/snang ba 'di thams cad rmi lam rang yin pa 'dug snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag tu sbyong ste/ dmigs pa tshar gcig song*/ yang rtsa dbu ma gsal 'debs pa sogs yang nas yang du kho na bskyar gyin bsgom/ thun mtshams su yang sgyu ma'i 'dun pa'i dod du rmi lam gyi 'dun pa bcug nas/ 'dun pa gsum sbrags bya ste/ mi rtag pa dang*/ mos gus dang*/ rmi lam gyi 'dun pa ste gsum mo/ rmi lam 'dun pa'i gnad bya ba yin pas 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug zas za ba gtam smra ba mdor na spyod lam thams cad du nga gnyid du song 'dugarmi lam rmi bar 'dug/rmi lam rang yin ang snyam pa rgyun chags su byung na/ rmi lam zin pa la tshegs med pas 'di rang gal che'o/ /de ltar bsgoms pas myur du rmi lam zin par 'gyur ro/ /yang las 'brel chung ba 'ga' la nyin par bstar chags su bsgoms kyang 'phral du ma zin par 'gor na yang zla ba gcig gam/

zla ba phyed dang gnyis tsam gyi bar du zin du re ba dang*/ ma zin gyi dogs pa'i rtsis btab mi byed par ci dgar bsgyur/ 'dun pa drag tu byed pa gal che/ spyir sngon gyi nā ro chos drug pa rnams/ dbang po rab tu gyur pa la/ lo yis zin par dag kyang srid zer/ lo gcig tsam bsgoms na rmi lam zin pa la brtan pa thob/ /ces 'dod par 'dug/chos 'di'i lugs kyis dben pa'i gnas su grib kyis ma phog/long gtam dang ma 'dres/ nges 'byung skyo shas dang bcas par bsgoms na/ zhag bdun nam bcu tshun la 'go tho re ba zin yong*/ de nas ma 'byams ma dred zhud kyis 'khyer bar bsgoms na/ zla ba gsum mam bzhi tshun chod la rmi lam zin cing brtan pa thob par 'ong ngo*/ /lar ma bsgoms pas kyang rmi lam na re zin pa 'ong ste/ de 'dra stes dbang tsam yin gtad pa cang med/ yang dang por bsgom ma thag rang du zin pa'ang yod de/ rkyen gsar ngas kyis zin pa zer/ rjes la mi yong*/ de 'dras zin pa'i go mi chod/ rgyun 'thud mi thub/ 'dir dmigs pa'i stobs kyis zin pa dang*/ 'dun pa'i stobs kyis zin pa cig dgos/ de 'dras zin na 'di lan gcig zin pa'i rjes su nyams len ma bshol na gong 'phel du song nas bstar chags su zin yong ba la dka' las med pa yin no/ /dmigs skor bcu dgu pa'o/ /gnyis pa gnad 'chug med dgu la brten pa ni/ dmigs pa snga ma'i spogs chog yin te/ spyir ni rang zin thig le dbang bzhi'i gnad nyid shin tu zab pas/ de kas rmi lam zin dgos kyang dgos 'ong yang 'ong*/ spogs chog 'di dag dgos pa cher mi 'ong*/ ci ste na/ dmigs pa snga ma 'bad pas bsgoms kyang zla shas ma zin na/ bogs 'don 'di rnams rim gyis bya ste/ de la gnad 'chug med dgu zhes bya ba/ dus kyi gnad gsum/ tho rangs/ nam langs/ nyi ma rtse shar ro lus kyi gnad gsum ni/ skyil krung/ tsog pu/ seng ge'i nyal stabs gsum mo/

/dmigs pa'i gnad gsum ni/ rtog med la bzung ba gnyis dang*/ rtog bcas lam du khyer ba'o/ /de ltar dgu las/ skabs 'dir dmigs pa'i gnad gsum mo/ /de la dang po rtog med la bzung ba dmigs pa'i gnad rgya bskyed pa ni/ dbu ma yi ge gnyis dang bcas pa gsal 'debs pa sngar bzhin/ de rjes rlung ro bsal/ steng rlung nang du rngubs pa dang lhan cig haṃ las thig le dkar po chad te snying gar sleb/ 'og rlung yar 'then pas hūṃ las thig le dmar po chad de snying gar sleb/ rlung kha sbyor du bzung skabs/ thig le gnyis po snying gar 'khor ba la sems gtad/ rmi lam gyi 'dun pa bya/ bum dbang ngo*/ /de rjes rlung phyir bsal ba'i dus thig le dkar po sna bug g.yas dang*/ dmar po g.yon nas thon te/ smin mtshams su 'khor ba la sems gtad de/ rmi lam gyi 'dun pa drag tu bya/ gsang dbang ngo*/ /thig le de gnyis rang gi mdun thad du babs te/ dkar po dpal 'khor lo sdom pa yab dang*/ dmar po rdo rje phag mor gyur/ kha sbyor lhan cig skyes pa'i skur gyur pa la sems gtad de rmi lam gyi 'dun pa drag tu bya/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo*/ /yum yab la thim/ de yang mkha' dbyings su yal kyi bar bsams te/ mi rtog pa la mnyam par bzhag/dbang bzhi pa'o/ /de las langs pa na rmi lam gyi 'dun pa drag tu sbyangs/ de nyid yang yang bskyar gyin bsgom/ thun mtshams kyi spyod lam sngar dang 'dra/ tshan mo nyal khar mdun gyi lhan skyes yab yum dbyings su yal ba de ka'i ngang der rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod par gnyid du 'gro bar bya/ bar skabs su gnyid sad na/ dmigs pa de yongs rdog tshar re bsgom thub na legs/ ma thub na rmi lam gyi 'dun pa re bya'o/ /nam smad gnyid kyi lhag ma cung zad re yod pa'i skabs der gnyid sangs te/ lus gnad bcas/ sngar gyi dmigs pa de la 'dun pa drag po dang bcas nas bsgom/

de rjes dus gnad gsum po gang rung gcig gi dus su slebs pa dag*/lus gnad gsum po gang rug zhig bcas te/ dmigs pa sngar gyi de ka rim can du bsgoms nas/ mthar thams cad yal ba'i ngang la rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa'i ngang nas gnyid du 'gro bar la/ sngar nas dmigs pa gong ma'ang zin thig le de bsgoms pa'i goms shugs che bar yod/ lan gcig po de ka la zin 'ong*/ goms shugs ha cang che ba med kyang zhag 'ga' re bskyar na zin 'ong ngo*/ /dmigs skor nyi shu pa'o/ /yang na dmigs pa'i gzhi mdor bsdus pa la bslab te/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor sngar bzhin bsgom/ rang gi snying gar bla ma sku dngos sam/ rdo rje 'chang dkar po/ de'i thugs kar hūm̐ yig dkar po 'od kyi rang bzhin can zhig bsgom/ bla ma la mos gus dang rmi lam gyi 'dun pa gnyis ldan du bsgoms te yid kyis gsol ba btab/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros snang ba thams cad khyab/ rmi lam yin snyam pa bya/ snang ba thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ bum dbang ngo*/ /rang yid dam du gsal ba la rmi lam gyi dran 'dun bya/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas hūm̐ la thim/ sher dbang ngo*/ /de la'ang rmi lam gyi dran 'dun bya/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas hūm̐ la thim/ sher dbang ngo*/ /de nas hūm̐ yang 'ja' ltar yal bar bsams la/ de ka'i ngang bskyang*/ dbang bzhi pa'o/ /de las rmi lam gyi 'dun pa drag tu sbyangs/ yang de nyid bskyar gyin thun grangs dang thun tshad med par bsgom pa yin te/ lag len de ltar bsgom dgos so/ /'jag bsam gnyis kar gyi khrid yig las/ phyi snod bcud rang la bsdu ba mi gsal ba dang*/ nyin mo'i dmigs pa la 'od gsal du bsdu ba yang mi gsal ba ni/ lag len cung zad sbas pa yin la/ mkhas grub gzhon nu grub ni/ 'od gsal bzung ba'i skabs dmigs pa bzhin rim pas spro bar yang bzhed do/ /de gnyis la rtog med la bzung ba zhes tha snyad mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan dngos su las la sbyor ba'i skabs/

dmigs pa bsdus nas gnyid du 'gro ba'i bar la/ rnam rtog gzhan gyi bar ma chod pa/ bsam med du gnas pa zhig dgos pa'i don yin no/ / dmigs skor nyer gcig pa'o/ /gnyis pa rtog bcas lam khyer ni/ sngon 'gro sngar dang 'dra ba las/ rang gi mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab bzhi/ padma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi par gyur pa'i lte bar oṃ dmar po de'i 'od dmar pos mgrin pa'i phyogs thams cad khyab par bsgom/ rlung bum can nam 'jam rlung bzung ste/ nyin phyed yan lag cis kyang do nub rmi lam zin par bya/ rmi lam la rmi lam du ngo shes par bya/ zhes 'dun pa drag po btang*/ nyin phyed man chad la nga gnyid du song 'dug/snang ba 'di rmi lam yin par 'dug snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag tu bya srod thun la da ni myur du rmi lam 'ong bas 'di nyid du ngo shes par byed dgos snyam pa'i 'dun pa gtong*/ de yang da lta'i sad dus kyi snang ba rags pa 'di nus gnyid 'thug po rang du ma song ba'i bar der/ gnyid dang snang ba'i bar gyi rnam rtog ces bya ba/ rna bar sgra tsi rong ba'am/ lus sbrid pa snyam dang*/ thib thib non pa'am/ smin mtshams su sbring sbring pa dang dbugs thum thum pa lta bu'i nyams kyi rjes su/ mi khyi la sogs pa'i 'gro ba dang*/ khang khyim dang*/ lam kha la sogs pa'i rnam pa srib tsam srib tsam 'ong ba/ 'og 'gyu las ni gsal/ rmi lam dngos las cung mi gsal ba'i snang cha srab srib tsam 'byung ba de la gnyid dang snang ba'i bar gyi rnam rtog zer ba yin/ skabs 'dir de rmi lam du ngo shes par byed dgos snyam du 'dun pa drag tu sbyang*/ gnas skabs de gsum la 'dun pa bsgyur ba ma gtogs dmigs pa 'dra/ dus gnad gsum du lus gnad gsum bcas nas 'dzin tshul yang gong dang 'dra mod/ dmigs pa'i yul stong par bsdus nas 'jog pa de mi byed pas/ oṃ yig la sems gtod cing*/ da lta rang gnyid dang snang ba'i bar gyi rnam rtog yong ba 'di ngos 'dzin dgos snyam pa'i 'dun pa'i shugs ha cang drag pa min tsam bsten pa'i sgo nas gnyid du 'gro bar bya/

der gnyid dang snang ba'i bar gyi rnam rtog byung na/ 'di ka rmi lam yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa bag tsam btang ste/ thur sel cung zad bskum gsung*/ 'on kyang bcas bcom mang na gnyid dengs 'gro bas 'dun pa bag tsam gyi ngang nas gnyid du 'gro bar bya/ gnyid dang snang ba'i bar gyi rnam rtog ngos 'dzin cing*/ de yang 'dun pa rtog bcas kyis 'dzin pas rtog bcas la ma khyer ces bya'o/ /'di rmi lam mi zin pa mi srid pa'i gdams pa'o gsung*/ 'dir 'jag bsam gser gling pa gsum kar gyi khrid yig las/ mgrin pa'i oṃ gyi bshad pa zur tsam mdzad nas chams te bzhag/nyin par gyi dmigs pa sngar gyi dmigs pa de ka bsgom gsung rtog med gnyis la kha 'phangs tshul mdzad pa dang*/ 'jag chen gyis/ yang na dmigs pa gnyis kyi bogs 'don du/ de gnyis rang mi sgom par rmi lam gyi 'dun pa spyi ldog de sbyong bar gsungs pa rnams kyis man ngag zhal shes la ltos pa'i dbang du mdzad pa'o/ /dmigs skor nyer gnyis pa'o/ /gnyis pa rmi lam sbyong ba ni/ rmi lam zin pa la brten pa thob nas rmi lam sbyong ba dgos pa yin te/ de yang rmi lam 'dzin pas dmigs pa bor nas/ sbyong ba kho na la bsgril ba'i dbang du byas pa yin/ 'dzin pa'i dmigs pa ma dor bar bstar chags su sgom gyin yod na/ nub re bzhin rmi lam lan re bzhin zin yong ba'i mtshams nas sbyong ba'i dmigs pa yang bsgoms te/ 'dzin sbyong phyogs gcig tu byas pas chog go /de la bzhi ste/ lus kyis sems sbyang ba/ sems kyis lus sbyang ba/ bdag med mas sbyang ba/ 'dun pas sbyang ba'o/ /de la dang po ni/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor yan chad rmi lam bzung ba'i skabs dang 'dra ba las/ rmi lam 'byongs par mdzad du gsol zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ de nas dmigs pa dngos ni/ rang nyid gnas pa'i 'og na/ brag phyams lta bu g.yang sa shin tu che bar zhig 'dug par bsam/ rang nyid kyang g.yang sa de'i kha mtshams mda' gang tsam gyi steng gi nam mkha' la 'dug par bsam/

de nas mar bltas pas yang ting gis 'byung*/ de tsa na nga gnyid du song 'dug/snang ba 'di rmi lam gyi snang bar 'dug/rmi lam gyi snang ba la skrag rgyu ci yod snyam ste/ chad kyis lhungs su bcug/sa la tob ter ma lhungs tsam la/ de nyid du yal bar bsam pa'am/ yang na yar la ye re re 'phur nas 'ongs te/ /g.yang gi khar sngar bzhin 'dug par mos/ tshul de lta bu yang yang sbyong*/ dmigs pa 'di la rang yi dam du gsal ba dang*/ tha mal gyi rnam pas sbyong ba gnyis kas rung bas nges med du bsgom/ yang g.yang sa'i rtser lus gcig bzhag nas/ de las 'od kyi thag pa dang 'bral ba'i lus gcig 'bab 'dzeg byed par yang bshad de/ zhal khrid la 'di mi gsung*/ dmigs skor nyer gsum pa'o/ /gnyis pa sems kyis lus sbyong ba ni/ sngon 'gro gong dang 'dra/ rang yi dam gyi sku gsal ba'i sgo dgu ru hūṃ yig sngon po 'od kyi rang bzhin chen po re dang*/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad du hūṃ sngon po 'od 'tsher ba phra mo dpag tu med pas go mtshams med par khyab/ hūṃ thams cad mgo bo nang du lta ba'o/ /rmi lam gyi 'dun pa drag tu sbyang*/ hūṃ thams cad las 'od zer sngon po dwangs gsal 'od kyi thag pa btang ba bzhin du sngo ta la la lus kyi nang du 'phros/ 'od rnams 'dus 'dus shing 'dus te gcig tu 'dres/ lus kyi phyi nang kyang g.yogs/ lha'i rnam pa 'dal te thams cad 'od kyi gong bu gcig tu song*/ yang rmi lam gyi 'dun pa drag tu sbyang*/ 'od kyi gong bu de mtha' nas rim gyis yal/ je phra je phra la khu tshur tsam/ mthe bong tsam/ sran chung tsam/ yungs 'bru tsam/ mthar de yang mi dmigs par sbyangs te/ sems rtog med la mnyam par bzhag/yang rnam rtog skyes na rmi lam gyi 'dun pa drag tu sbyang ngo*/ /dmigs skor nyer bzhi pa'o/ /gsum pa bdag med mas sbyong ba ni/ gzhan sngar ltar las/ dngos gzhi ni rang 'khor lo sdom pa yab rkyang du gsal ba'i mdun du rdo rje bdag med ma/

sku mdog sngon mo gri gug thod khrag kha ṭāṃ 'dzin pa/ lang tsho dang bde ba rgyas pa zhig bsgom/ sku de che na mda' gang khru gang tsam/ chung na sor bzhi'am mthe bong tsam/ de dag gi bar gang bde yin/ de'i gsang bar oṃ ā swāhā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyi yig 'bru gsal bar bsgom/ rmi lam gyi dran 'dun drag po'i ngang nas/ sngags de lan nyer gcig sogs ci rigs par bzlas pas/ de las 'od zer sngon po sngo tal gyis byung*/ rang he ru kar gsal ba'i sku la phog pas/ rang nyid lha sku sngar las kyang sngo zhing dwangs pa/ gsal ba zhig tu song*/ lus thams cad bde bas khyab par bsam/ yang rmi lam gyi 'dun pa dang bcas nas/ bdag med ma'i sku la sems gtad pas/ bdag med ma de nyid 'od zer sngon po nyams bde ba dang ldan pa zhig tu ltem gyis zhu/ rang nyid he ru ka'i skur gsal ba'i gsang ba'i sgo nas zhugs 'od des sku lus kyi nang thams cad khyab/ sngar las kyang sngo zhing dwangs la gsal bar song*/ lus sems thams cad bde bas gang bar mos/ de nyid je dwangs je dwangs la nam mkha' la 'dres shing thim par bsam/ der cung zad bzhag ste/ yang rmi lam gyi 'dun pa drag tu sbyong ba sogs sngar bzhin dmigs pa 'di la mkhas grub rgyal mtshan 'bum ni rang gi dbang po'i rtse la hūṃ bsgom gsung ba yod kyang*/ zhal khrid la de mi mdzad/ su kha'i 'dres shor ram gsung ngo*/ /dmigs skor nyer lnga pa'o/ /bzhi pa 'dun pas sbyang ba ni/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor yan chad sngon 'gro sngar bzhin/ 'di la ni dmigs pa'i gzhi gcig tu nges pa med de/ 'dun pa kho nas rtsal nges med du sbyong bas na 'dun pas sbyong ba'o/ /de yang nga'i lus na tsha sdug bsngal skyed par byed pa de mal na yod par 'dug/snang ba 'di rmi lam gyi snang ba yin/ lus 'di yang rmi lam gyi yid lus yin/ rmi lam gyi snang ba dang*/ yid kyi lus la ci sbyangs sbyangs su 'gro ba yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po rgyun chags su byas nas/

rang gi mdun na 'dug pa'i ka ba gyang rtsig pa thog phub sogs la yar thal mar thal phar thal tshur thal thogs med du sbyang*/ gzhan yang dkar khung phra mo la 'dzul pa sogs dang*/ g.yang sa dang*/ chu dang*/ me dang*/ gcan gzan sogs la thog brdzis su byed pa dang*/ nam mkha' la 'phur ba dang*/ sa la 'dzul ba dang*/ chu'i steng nas 'chag pa sogs mdor na ci dran gyi tshul gyis sbyangs pas chog pa las/ khyad par du rnam rtog choms dka' ba'i rigs 'dzin chags kyi dngos po dang*/ 'jigs skrag dang*/ ya nga dang*/ ngo tsha dang*/ skyug bro skye ba'i rigs rnams la/ res 'ga' thug phrad thog brdzis bya/ res 'ga' sgyu ma rmi lam gyi 'dun pas bza' gtad med par bya/ res 'ga' nyam nga med par ldog sgom bya/ res 'ga' skad cig gcig la thogs med du bcom mo/ /dmigs skor nyer drug pa'o/ /lus kyis sems sbyong ba rmi lam rtsal sbyong yin/ sems kyis lus sbyong ba 'od gsal dang bsre ba yin pas phrugs gcig tshar/ bdag med mas sbyong ba 'od gsal dang bsre ba yin/ 'dun pas sbyong ba rtsal sbyong yin pas rmi lam sbyong tshul gnad phrugs gcig de la tshang bas/ gang zag gcig gis de gnyis gang rung re bsgom par bya'o/ /gsum pa rmi lam spel pa la/ thug phrad du spel ba dang*/ gang 'dul du spel ba gnyis/ dang po la yang 'byung bzhi phra rags la spel ba dang*/ sems can phra rags la spel ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ sngon 'gro sngar dang 'dra ba las/ rmi lam spel nus par byin gyi rlobs zhes mtha' bsgyur la gsol ba btab/ de nad dper mtshon na/ rang gi mdun du sa'i gong bu zhig mthong gin 'dug na/ nga gnyid du song 'dug/'di rmi lam gyi sa yin par 'dug /ci spel bar der 'gro snyam nas/ gnyis su spel snyam tsa na gnyis su song*/ de bzhin du thog ma re zhig gsum nas bcu la sogs pa'i bar du spel/ yang rim pas bsdus pas rtsa ba'i gcig pur song*/
