mthar rim pas bslabs shing sbyangs pas/ gang 'dod 'dod du spel yang nus rtsa ba'i sa gcig pa la bsdu bar yang nus pa 'byung ngo*/ /de yang nyin par dmigs pa 'di yang yang bsgoms pas/ mtshan mo rmi lam zin/ spel ba'i dmigs pa 'di dran nas bsgoms kyang*/ kha cig la thog mar spel ba dang*/ bsdu ba mi 'byung ba yang yod de/ yang 'dun pa drag pos bsgoms na/ zhag shas nas cung zad spel thub par 'ong*/ de nas rim pas je bzang du 'gro/ 'ga' zhig la thog ma nyid nas spel nus pa'ang yong*/ 'dir ma zad sprul bsgyur la de dang 'dra/ dang po sa'i gong bu lta bu zhig la goms par byas nas/ spro bsdu thub pa na/ de nas gzhan la'ang rim gyis bslab ste/ sa khams rags pa ri lta bu nas/ phra ba rde'u'am sa rdul gyi bar la bslab/ chu khams rags pa chu bo dang*/ mtsho la sogs pa nas phra ba chu thigs kyi bar la bslab/ me khams rags pa med dpung chen po nas phra ba me stag gi bar la bslab/ rlung khams rags pa rlung 'tshub chen po nas/ phra ba srog chags phra mo'i dbugs 'gyu ba tshun chad la'ang bslab/ 'dir 'byung bzhi zhes pa bem chos sems med thams cad la zer ba yin te/ phyi snod kyis bsdus pa thams cad la sbyong ba yin/ dmigs skor nyer bdun pa'o/ /gnyis pa sems can phra rags la sbyang ba ste/ sngon 'gro gong dang 'dra/ rang gi mdun du thug phrad du mi lta bu zhig mthong na/ nga gnyid du song 'dug/ 'di rmi lam gyi snang ba'i mir 'dug/ci spel spel yin snyam pa dang*/ gcig gnyis gsum nas bcu'i bar du spel zhing*/ gong bzhin bsdu ba sogs bya/ des mtshon pa'i rta glang sogs sems can dngos su mthong ba thams cad la bslab ste/ rags pa rta glang la sogs pa nas phra ba 'bu srin phra mo'i bar la bslab bo/ /dmigs skor nyer brgyad pa'o/ /gnyis pa gang 'dul la bslab pa la/ 'jig rten pa'i gang 'dul dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gang 'dul gnyis/

dang po 'jig rten pa'i gang 'dul du spel ba ni/ gtso bor srog chags kyi gzugs la sbyong ba yin/ me chu sogs sems med la yang sbyong ni sbyong ba yin te me'i gnyen por chu spel sprul byed pa lta bu'o/ /dper na/ mdun du byi ba lta bu zhig mthong na/ 'di rmi lam gyi byi ba yin/ 'di la 'dul byed cig spel dgos snyam pa byas te/ der byi la zhig byung*/ des byi ba de btul bar bsam/ de nas ci spel spel yin snyam pas/ byi la mang por spel nas 'dul ba'i dmigs pa byed pa'o/ /de bzhin du bye'u la khra lta bu dang*/ khyi la spyang ki /gcan gzan gzhan la stag dang*/ stag la seng ge dang*/ seng ge la me dpung*/ me la chu/ mi la srin po sogs la yang sbyar bar bya'o/ /dmigs skor nyer dgu pa'o/ /gnyis pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gang 'dul du spel ba ni/ rang ngam gzhan la gdon gyi gnod byed yod na/ rang gi mdun du khro ba'i rgyal bo gcig byung nas/ des gnod byed kyi gdon de zhags pas 'ching ba dang*/ zhabs kyi gnon pa dang*/ mtshon chas btub pa dang*/ me ris sreg pa dang*/ sngags kyis sgra drag po bsgrags pas skrag nas dran med du brgyal bar byed pa sogs thabs sna tshogs kyis slar ldang thes med par bcom par bsam/ yang khro bo de lta bu mang por spel bas kyang 'dul bar bsam/ de la ye shes khro bo gang gis kyang*/ gdon rigs thams cad 'dul bar nus mod de/ gtso che ba'i gang 'dul gyi dbang du byas na/ rgyal po dang btsan 'dul ba la rta mgrin/ steng gdon la phyag na rdo rje/ sa bdag klu gnyan spyi la bya khyung*/ klu srin la 'jam dpal nā rakṣa/ bdud kyi bar chad la mi g.yo ba/ rbod gtong la gtsug gtor 'khor los bsgyur ba/ gdon spyi la 'jam dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed bsngags zhes gsung ngo*/ /dmigs skor sum cu pa'o/ /bzhi pa rmi lam sprul pa'i gdams ngag la/ thug phrad du sprul pa dang*/

gang 'dul du sprul pa gnyis/ dang po thug phrad du sprul pa la dbye na/ 'byung bzhi phra rags su sprul pa dang*/ sems can phra rags su sprul pa gnyis so/ / dang po ni/ sngon 'gro'i skabs rmi lam sprul nus par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces mtha' bsgyur nas gzhan gong dang 'dra/ rang gi mdun du sa'i gong bu lta bu zhig mthong na/ nga gnyid du song 'dug/sar snang ba 'di rmi lam gyi sar 'dug/ nga rang yang 'di dang 'dra bar sa'i gong bur sprul dgos snyam 'dun pa btang zhing*/ de ma thag tu rang nyid sa'i gong bu de 'dra ba zhig tu song*/ rmi lam rang yin snyam du cung zad bsgoms/ yang de 'phro bcad nas gzhan la mig gtad yengs su bcug ste/ rmi lam gyi 'dun pa drag po bya/ de lta bu yang yang bskyar zlos byed kyin bsgom mo/ /des mtshon nas 'byung bzhi phra rags gzhan thams cad la yang sbyar te/ dmigs skor so gcig pa'o/ /gnyis pa sems can phra rags su sprul pa yang snga ma rnams kyis rigs 'gre/ rang gi mdun du mi gcig mthong na/ e ma 'di rmi lam gyi mir 'dug/ bdag kyang 'di lta bu gcig tu sprul dgos snyam pa bya/ de ma thag rang nyid kyang de 'dra bar song bar bsam/ rmi lam gyi 'dun pa bcas te cung zad sems bzung*/ yang 'phro bcad de rmi lam yin snyam pa byed/ de lta bu la bskor ldog bya'o/ /srog chags gzhan la sbyor tshul yang gong dang 'dra/ dmigs skor so gnyis pa'o/ /gnyis pa gang 'dul du sprul pa la/ 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa gnyis yod/ dang po ni/ gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba las/ rang gi mdun du byi ba lta bu zhig mthong na/ 'di rmi lam gyi byi bar 'dug/'di 'dul dgos de la bdag byi lar sprul par bya snyam pas/ rang nyid de ma thag byi lar song*/ byi ba de lhag med du bcom par bsam/ des gzhan rnams la yang rigs 'gre/ dmigs skor so gsum pa'o/ /gnyis pa 'jig rten 'das pa'i gang 'dul ni/

rang ngam gzhan gyi don du bdag nyid rtog dpyad yod pa'i 'dre gdon de mdun du 'dug par bsam/ 'di rmi lam gyi 'dre gdon yin/ 'dul dgos snyam du rang skad cig gis khro bo chen por gyur nas/ zhags pas 'ching ba dang*/ bcom brdeg byed pa sogs gong bzhin 'dul thabs byas pas lhag ma tsam yang med par brlag par byas/ rmi lam rang yin ang*/ dngos por grub pa ni cung zad kyang med snyam pa bya/ de ltar yang yang bskyar ro/ /gzhan gong spel ba'i skabs bzhin no/ /de la spel ba ni mdun du yod pa de spel ba yin*/ sprul pa ni rang nyid sprul pa yin te/ de yang phal cher la spel ba ni cung zad sla zhing de las sprul pa cung zad dka' bas/ spel ba sngon dang*/ sprul pa rjes su bstan pa yin no/ /der ma zad 'jig rten 'das pa'i gang 'dul gyi skabs/ thog ma dmigs pa ma 'byongs pa'i dus na/ rmi lam rang du rang nyid sprul thub kyang pha rol po de mi thul ba la/ khro bo zhig mdun du byon nas btul na thul ba zhig 'ong*/ de'i rgyu mtshan rang la mi tha mal dang gces 'dzin gyis bag yod pas/ rang pham dogs kyi nyam nga yod/ mdun gyi lha la de lta bu med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin gsung*/ dmigs skor so bzhi pa'o/ /lnga pa rmi lam bsgyur ba'i gdams ngag la/ 'byung bzhi phra rags su bsgyur ba/ sems can phra rags su bsgyur ba/ lha sku sna tshogs su bsgyur ba/ snang stong zhen bral du bsgyur ba ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/ rmi lam bsgyur nus par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces mtha' bsgyur/ gzhan sngon 'gro la khyad med/ phyi ma gsum la'ang des rigs 'gre/ rang gi mdun du bum pa lta bu zhig 'dug na/ nga gnyid du song bar gda'/ bum par snang ba 'di yang rmi lam du gda'/ rmi lam gyi bum pa la gang byas byas yin ci bsgyur bsgyur yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa shugs drag pos bum pa 'di me thab tu bsgyur dgos snyam tsa na me thab tu song*/

de ka bar bsgyur snyam pa na ka bar song*/ de dag la sogs pa gang dran dran du ngo bo tshad dbyibs grangs kha dog nges med du bsgyur/ de ltar bum pa lta bu zhig sna tshogs su bsgyur thub na/ sa chu me rlung sa rdo ri brag rtsi shing nags tshal sogs phan tshun rnam pa sna tshogs su bsgyur tshul zad pa med pa la bslab bo/ /dmigs skor so lnga pa'o/ /gnyis pa sems can phra rags su bsgyur ba yang des rigs 'gre/ rang gi mdun du mi lta bu zhig mthong na/ 'di rmi lam gyi mi yin/ ci bsgyur bsgyur yin/ gang bsams bsams yin snyam pas de rta ru bsgyur snyam tsa na rta ru song*/ de yang glang po cher bsgyur/ de yang ba glang rnga mong la sogs par bsgyur/ de yang mi dang dud 'gro srog chags nang phan tshun rnam pa sna tshogs par bsgyur ro/ / 'byung bzhi dang sems can du bsgyur ba'i skabs 'di dag tu kha dog ma nges pa/ dbyibs ma nges pa/ tshad ma nges pa/ grangs ma nges pa sna tshogs par bsgyur ba'ang dgos so/ /dmigs skor so drug pa'o/ /gsum pa lha sku sna tshogs su bsgyur ba ni/ gzhan rnams sngar dang 'dra ba las/ bden med dang rmi lam gyi 'dun pa drag po'i ngang nas/ rang nyid bde mchog lhan skyes kyi sku gsal por bsgom/ ga re nga gnyid du song 'dug/lha skur snang ba 'di yang rmi lam du 'dug/gang bsgyur ba der 'gro snyam pas/ rang nyid bde mchog de dgyes mdzad du bsgyur dgos snyam pa na/ dgyes mdzad su song*/ de yang gsang 'dus su/ de mahā mā ya ru/ /de rdo rje 'jigs byed du bsgyur ba sogs yi dam lha'i ngo bo sna tshogs su bsgyur/ de bzhin du lha gcig kyang sku mdog ma nges pa sna tshogs su bsgyur te/ dkar po sngon po dang*/ de dmar por bsgyur ba la sogs pa dang*/ de bzhin du zhal phyag ma nges pa sna tshogs su bsgyur te/ zhal phyag mang po nyur ngur bsgyur ba dang*/ nyung ngu mang por bsgyur ba dang*/

/gdong brnyan sogs sna tshogs par bsgyur ba'o/ /dmigs skor so bdun pa'o/ /bzhi pa snang stong zhen bral du bsgyur ba ni/ lha sku sna tshogs su bsgyur ba sngon du btang*/ de yang rtsa ba'i lha sku rgya cher spel/ spel ba thams cad sna tshogs su bsgyur/ de thams cad sgyu ma lta bu rmi lam lta bu'i 'dun pa drag tu sbyang*/ yang lha skur snang ba dang*/ snang mkhan gyi sems la char re bltas pas/ sgyu ma sgyu 'dzin dang bral/ de ka'i ngang der gang yang mi dmigs pa'i 'od gsal phyag rgya chen por rang shugs su 'byung/ yang de lta bu'i ngang nas rtsa ba'i lha skur skyed pa sogs gong bzhin yang yang sbyang*/ de ltar sbyangs pas mtshan mo rmi lam gyi dus su lha sku mang nyung ci rigs la de ltar bsgom pa 'byung*/ de nas je mang la 'gro/ mthar rmi lam du lha sku nam mkha' khengs pa gcig gis gcig ma bsgribs pa/ de thams cad kyang bde la zhen pa med pa/ gsal la rtog pa med pa/ snang la rang bzhin med pa ste/ mtshan nyid gsum ldan du 'char/ de'i tshe rmi lam nying 'khrul rang dag gi dge sbyor klungs su phebs pa yin no/ /de yang sgyu ma zhes pa ni/ sad dus dang rmi lam du bden med kyi 'dun pa sbyangs pa de'i shugs kyis a 'thas med par yul le/ mtho dman med par mnyam khad de shar ba de la zer/ sgyu mar 'dzin pa dang bral ba zhes pa ni/ 'di kun 'khrul snang du shar ba tsam las gtad pa rang ci yod snyam pa'i blo zhig yod pa de yang dbyibs su yal de dgag sgrub kyi 'dzin pa dang bral ba de yin/ skabs der gang yang mi rtog bzhin du nyams myong gi ro bde bar shar ba de 'od gsal yin/ de ka la phyag rgya chen po zer te/ sems kyi gnas lugs yin pas so/ /yang de ka'i ngang nas lha sku gsal stong rang du byung ba de la yang phyag rgya chen po zhes bya'o/ /bde la zhe pa med pa ni/ rmi lam du lha sku rang shar ba'i dus/

lus sems gnyis ka la bde nyams lam me shar yang nga rgyal rlom sems med cing*/ bde ba de la yang sred pa med pas/ bde ba byung ma byung la dga' mi dga' med pa zhig 'ong*/ gsal la rtog pa med pa ni/ lha sku'i rnam pa shin tu gsal bar snang yang de rang shar yin te/ rnam rtog gi rtsol ba med pa'o/ /snang ba rang bzhin med pa ni/ snang yang bden pas stong zer ba'i spyi skad de yang 'dir 'jug pa tsam yin mod de/ 'on kyang 'dir ni lus sems dang*/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i snang ba cig car shar ba de/ rig par rang gsal gcig po'i ngor mnyam khad de shar ba ma gtogs/ snang ba so so rnams la dngos po tha dad gang yang med par nyams su myong ba'o/ /dmigs skor so brgyad pa'o/ /rmi lam gyi skabs 'di dag tu/ 'byams gcod kyi man ngag dag kyang gal che ste/ 'byams gcod rgyas pa ni logs su bstan pa ltar yin pas khrid kyi dkyus la mi 'chad cing*/ 'byams gcod nyer mkho zhal shes mar grags pa ni gzhan du gsal lo/ /drug pa yul snang gtan la dbab pa la/ dbang po rab dmigs med gsal mkhyen/ 'bring gang bsams gsal mthong*/ tha ma yid lus mkha' lding*/ dman pa dmigs pa'i yul snang ste bzhi yod pa las/ dang po dmigs med gsal mkhyen ni/ sbyor ba'i skabs su 'bad rtsol med kyang*/ lkog gyur gyi don thams cad nyin mo sad dus dang*/ mtshan mo rmi lam gyi skabs thams cad du mthong ba'o/ /'bring gang bsam gsal mthong ni/ nyin mo 'dun pa gang gtad pa de thams cad mtshan mo rtsol med rang shar du mthong ba'o/ /tha ma yid lus mkha' lding ni/ sngon 'gro gzhan 'dra ba la/ yul snang gtan la phebs par mdzad du gsol/ zhes mtha' bsgyur nas gsol ba btab/ dmigs pa dngos ni/ bdag do nub sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di lta bu lta ba'am/ lkog gyur 'di lta bu blta bar bya/ zhes 'dun pa drag tu btang*/ de nas rmi lam dngos yin snyam pas rang nyid yi dam gyi skur gsal ba de nyid dam/

lus kyi rnam pa gzhan du sprul kyang rung ste/ nam mkha' la yer gyis 'phur bas gnas der phyin ci dgos don rnams mthong bar bsam pas/ mtshan mo rmi lam du'ang de ltar 'byung ba'o/ /'dir yid lus mkha'i lding zhes pas mkha' lding ni/ nam mkha' la 'phur 'gro ba'i don tsam ka yin na'ang la la dag mkha' lding bya khyung lta bur sprul nas 'gro ba'i don du 'chad pa'ang yod do/ /dmigs skor so dgu pa'o/ /bzhi pa dman pa dmigs pa'i yul snang gi gdams ngag la gsum ste/ bdag med ma yul snang gsal byed/ a yul snang gsal byed/ thig le yul snang gsal byed do/ /dang po ni/ sngon 'gro snga ma dang 'dra/ rang gi lte ba'i 'og tu 'od kyi rang bzhin gyi thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ de'i nang du oṃ a swāhā/ kha dog sngon po 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba'o/ /de las 'od zer 'phros/ chos 'byung dang rang lus gang*/ ba spu'i bu ga nas 'phros/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang*/ nang bcud kyi sems can yi dam du bsam/ 'od zer gyi rtse mo las mchod pa dpag tu med pa sprul/ gdod nas bzhugs pa dang gsar du song ba'i yi dam lha tshogs thams cad mchod par bsam/ gzugs su snang tshad lha sku/ sgra grags tshad sngags/ dran rigs thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam du dran par bya/ yang 'od zer tshur 'dus te/ lte ba'i sngags kyi yig 'bru la thim/ de nyid rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma'i skur gyur/ sngags kyi sgra di ri ri 'dug/mchod pa phul/ yul snang gtan la phebs par mdzad du gsol/ ces gsol ba btab/ nyin par gyi dmigs pa zhal khrid nges can 'di yin/ gzhan 'jag lugs la sngags las 'od zer lan mang po spros pas/ bdag med mas dbu byas pa'i yi dam sna tshogs byung*/ gnyis pa spros pas mchod pa 'bul/ snga ma sna bug g.yas dang*/ rting ma g.yon nas spro bsam sdings pa/ lte bar thod pa'i nang du bdag med ma/ de'i lte bar thod pa'i nang du sngags bsgom/

'od zer spro thengs gcig ka yin te/ sna bug g.yas nas byed/ lus gnyis kar la 'od zer tshur bsdu ba med do/ /'od zer sngags la bsdus te/ lhar bskyed pa 'di/ gser gling pa'i khrid yig la snang ngo*/ /mtshan mo nyal kha'i dmigs pa ni/ sngar gyi dmigs pa de tshar gcig bsgoms pa'i rjes la/ mchod pa bzhi rdzogs su phul/ yi dam gyi lha khyed kyis do nub kyi gnas skabs su bdag gis/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing dpag tu med pa mthong ba dang*/ mchod pa rgya chen po 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ ces pa dang*/ 'dod don dmigs bsal phra mo yod na/ de dang de mthong bar mdzad du gsol/ ces kyang bya/ de nas bdag med ma zhal tshur bstan te/ thugs ka'i thad ka shin tu dwangs pa la gang ltar bar 'dod pa'i yul de me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar khra sal le mthong bar bsam/ des rmi lam gyi dus su yul snang gtan la phabs so/ /thod pa'i tshab tu chos 'byung bsgom kyang rung gsung ngo*/ /dmigs skor bzhi bcu pa'o/ /gnyis pa thig le yul snang gsal byed ni/ sngon 'gro sngar ltar la/ rang lhar gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus su/ rtsa dbu ma kha dog dkar po dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin sbom phra sba lcag tsam pa/ yas snar haṃ dkar po mgo bo thur bstan/ mas snar hūṃ dmar sngo mgo gyen bstan/ lte bar a thung dmar po yang gyen bstan no/ /rlung ro bsal steng rlung rngubs pas ham̐ las thig le dkar po sran rdaug tsam chad nas snying gar sleb/ 'og rlung bskum pas hūṃ las thig le dmar sngo sran 'bru tsam yang chad/ lto ba zhom slog gis byas pas/ a las thig le shin tu dmar pa sran ma phyed tsam pa zhig yar chad/ de gnyis kyang snying gar sleb/ thig le gsum po gcig ru 'dres/ dkar la dmar pa yid tsam sngo ba'i mdangs chags pa gcig tu song*/ de 'od mer re 'dug pa la cung zad sems gtad/ yul snang blta bar bya snyam pa'i 'dun pa dang lhan cig rlung phy-ir bsal bas snying ga'i thig le la 'od zer dkar dmar thag pa'am sbrul 'dra rung zhig rgyangs te byung nas sna bug g.yon nas thon/

gang blta bar 'dod pa'i gnas der song*/ 'od des mun khung du sgron me btegs pa ltar yul de khra gsal gyis mthong ba'am/ yang na 'od zer de sbubs stong lta bur byas/ de'i nang nas bltas pas mthong bar bsgom kyang rung gsungs/ dmigs pa 'di'i rlung gnad dang thig le dmar sngo de zhal shes yin/ dmigs skor zhe gcig pa'o/ /gsum pa a yig yul snang gsal byed ni/ sngon 'gro dang rtsa dbu ma sngar bzhin bsgom/ dbu ma'i nang lte bar a dkar po dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can bsgom/ rmi lam gyi 'dun pa dang bcas bum can 'jam rlung cung zad bsgom/ de mtshams nas a las 'od zer dkar po'i thag pa rgyangs te spros/ rtsa dbu ma la thogs med du song sna bug nas thon te gang blta 'dod pa'i phyogs der song nas mun khung du sgron me bteg pa ltar khra gsal gyi mthong ba'am/ 'od kyi spu gu nas lta ba gang rung bya'o/ /dmigs skor zhe gnyis pa'o/ /dman pa yul snang gi dmigs pa gsum po 'di/ gang zag gcig gis gsum gang bsgoms dgos par rang ma yin/ gang rung re res kyang chog pas don la snga phyi'i go rim med/ tshogs su 'chad pa'i skabs/ bshad pa'i go rim la/ khrid yig rnying pa gsum na thog mar bdag med ma/ de nas a yul snang gsal byed dang*/ de rjes thig le yul snang gsal byed bshad yod kyang*/ 'dir phyi ma gnyis go rim bsnor ma ni/ dmigs pa rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi rim pa'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /gsang 'dus rim lnga'i gdams ngag sogs su/ spel sprul bsgyur gsum/ sbyong ba'i nang tshan du byas kyang*/ chos 'dir sbyong ba las logs su byed pa mi 'gal te/ sbyong ba zhes pa'i ngos 'dzin la mi 'dra ba'i khyad yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin no/ /de yang gzhan de dag tu ni/ rmi lam gyi rtsal spyod thams cad la sbyong ba zer bar 'dug/'dir ni rmi lam zin pa'i rjes su sna tshogs su bsgyur ba'i rtsal ma skyes pa skyed par byed pa'i thabs kyi nang sel gcig la sbyong ba dang*/

de nyid gong nas gong du spel ba la/ 'byongs nas spel sprul bsgyur gsum byed ces pa'o/ /yul snang lta ba ni/ rmi lam gyi rnam thar du grags pa/ yon tan skyes pa'i rtags ston pa tsam yin no/ /yang man ngag gzhan las bzung ba sbyong ba gcig tu byed pa zhes 'byung ba'i phyi ma ni/ rmi lam 'od gsal sogs su bsre ba la zer/ 'dir sems kyis lus sbyang ba dang*/ bdag med mas sbyang ba dang*/ bsgyur ba phyi ma gnyis la sogs pa'o/ /des na rmi lam gyi gdams ngag la/ dang por rmi lam la rmi lam du ngo ma shes na/ chos tshan 'di'i dge sbyor gyi rtsa ba stongs pas/ thog mar rmi lam rmi tshad zin pa zhig dgos/ don de la 'dzin pa'i gdams ngag ston/ de nas rtsal phyogs med du 'byongs pa zhig dgos pa la/ rmi lam nyid kyi snang ba la dbang 'byor pa'i phyir/ sbyong ba snga phyi gnyis dang*/ spel ba dang*/ sprul pa dang*/ bsgyur ba dang po gnyis dang*/ yul snang rnams byung ba yin/ rmi lam nyid du mchog gi dge sbyor dngos gzhi skyes pa la/ rmi lam 'od gsal du 'jug pa dang*/ rmi lam lha sku rang shar du 'jug pa gnyis yod pa las/ dang po ni sbyang ba bar pa gnyis yin/ phyi ma ni lha sku sna tshogs dang snang stong zhen bral du bsgyur ba'o/ /de ltar shes na mkhas rlom kha cig ni gu'i chos drug rmi lam gyi gdams ngag ma yang gnad chung zer ba'i bab bcol gyi smra ba de dag 'brel med byung rgyal gyi tshig tu go bar 'gyur ro/ /chos drug 'di'i dbu zhabs kyi gdams ngag thams cad las dang po pa nyid la mchog tu phan pa 'phral du rtags thon thon pa kho na yin gyi/ las dang po pa la phan pa ci yang med pa'i bshad pa mtho mtho mo la gdams ngag tu rlom pa de 'dra gtan ma yin cing*/ yang blun po rang bzo'i chos gzhung la brten pa'i legs bshad kyang med/ man ngag la brten pa'i lag len yang med pa'i 'ad 'ud shab shob rnams dang ni ye mi 'dra bar yang nges shes 'drongs so/

/bzhi pa 'od gsal gti mug rang sangs kyi khrid la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi khrid gsum bdog/dang po la rtsa ba mi rtag skyo shas/ yal ga spyod lam dam rdzas/ lo 'dab thabs lam rang mdangs/ gsol 'debs me tog 'char byed de bzhi las/ dang po rtsa ba mi rtag skyo shas ni/ nges par 'chi ba dang*/ nam 'chi cha med pa dang*/ 'gro drug khams gsum 'khor ba thams cad sdug bsngal du shes pas cis kyang*/ dgos med kyi blo drag tu bsgom/ snga nas mi rtag pa'i khrid ma bskyangs na smos ci dgos/ bskyangs pa tsho yang skabs 'dir mi rtag pa'i khrid bskyar nas bsgom dgos/ spyir chos kyi bskul ma 'chi ba mi rtag skyo shas shas cher bsgoms pas shes pa dwangs shing grung ba zhig 'byung*/ des shugs brtas te gnyid kyi dus na'ang*/ rig pa dwangs pa zhig 'byung*/ des kyang 'od gsal zin bla/ yang skyo shas can de rig pa la lcag chug gzeg thon pas gnyid 'thug po'i skabs kyang dran pa 'byung sla ste/ dper na/ nyin mo rig pa la sgrin chug pa'i dogs pa yod na mtshan mo gnyid chung bar 'gro bas mtshon no/ /de ltar na/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mas kyang*/ /'chi ba rgyud skyes 'od gsal 'char/ /zhes gsung*/ gnyis pa yal ga spyod lam dam rdzas la/ spyod lam ni/ ji skad du/ spyod lam dal la kha zas snum/ /rngul thon las rnams spang bar bya/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar/ nad pa'i spyod lam bzhin du bya ba byed dgos rnams bus byed/ kha zas snum pa ste/ lus la 'phrod pa mang nyung ran par bsten/ mchong rgyug dang rtsal 'gran dang 'dzing kha dang gzhu 'gengs sogs rtsa rlung 'khrugs par 'gyur pa dang rngul thon pa'i spyod lam spang gsung*/ dam rdzas ni spyir tshogs dang gtor ma bzang du bshams te 'bul/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga la gtor ma phul/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po la yang gtor ma phul nas gsol ba 'debs/ gtor ma 'bul ba'i skabs/ gu gul dang*/

mahā maṃ sa'i 'dug spos gtong zhes gsung*/ gsum pa lo 'dab thabs lam rang mdangs ni/ sngar gtum mo'i rnal 'byor la goms pa yin na/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la bsgoms pa de kas go chod pa yin pas logs pa mi dgos/ de man 'jam rlung bum pa can zla re tsam sbyong ba sngon du 'gro bar byed/ 'od gsal dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa bsgom skabs kyang snga dro'am/ phyi dro gang 'thad re la ngal dub du mi 'gyur ba tsam gyi rlung thun re bsgom par bya'o/ /rlung gi rnal 'byor gyis khams dwangs snyigs phyed/ dwangs ma'i mdangs las 'od gsal 'char ba yin pas/ rtsa rlung bsgom pa gnad du che/ spyir chos drug gi ya gyal 'od gsal ni/ gnyid kyi 'od gsal gtso bor 'chad pa'i skabs yin pas/ gtum mo dang 'od gsal zhes so sor bgrangs pa yin gyi/ gzhan du na nyin mo'i 'od gsal skyed pa'i thabs kyi mchog cig gtum mo 'di yin/ ril 'dzin rjes zhig sad sud dang*/ phra thig than thun ga las kyang 'di stobs che'o/ /bzhi pa gsol 'debs me tog 'char byed ni ji skad du/ /'od gsal 'char byed bla ma'i mos gus dang*/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'od gsal 'char ba la bla ma'i mos gus gal che/ 'o na bla ma'i mos gus ni sgom thams cad la gal che yi/ 'od gsal kho na gal che bar smos pa ci yin snyam na/ spyir bla ma'i mos gus kyi rten 'brel 'grig pa zhig kun la dgos kyang*/ nyin bar gyi dge sbyor rnams rang gi rtsol bas kyang bsgom du btub la/ rmi lam gyi skabs yin na yang rmi lam nyid kyi snang ba sna tshogs dang*/ dran rtog gi blo rags pa 'di yod cing*/ de yod pas nyin mo'i bag chags rmi lam du khrid pa'i phyir/ rang gi rtsol ba dang 'dun pas sleb rgyu zhig kyang yod pa'i phyir byin rlabs kho na la ltos pa rang yang min/ gnyid 'thug po'i dus na dran rtsol med pa'i phyir/ gnyid kyi 'od gsal 'di ni/

skabs de nyid du rang shar du byung na ma gtogs/ gzhan bsgom thes med pa'i phyir/ lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i rten 'brel dang*/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha'i byin rlabs 'jom pa la re ba yin no/ /de ltar sngon 'gro bzhi po de la sngar ma bstan pa'i dmigs pa gsar ba rkang tshugs med pas/ dmigs skor logs su mi 'dren/ chos thun gcig la rdzogs pa'am/ gnyis sam gsum sogs gang ltar byas kyang 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ 'od gsal gzung ba dang*/ lam khyer dang*/ bsre ba dang*/ mthar thug ste sa bcad bzhi'o/ /dang po la/ bdag med ma la brten te 'od gsal 'dzin pa/ a yig la brten te 'od gsal 'dzin pa/ bla ma la brten te 'od gsal 'dzin pa ste gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ thun gyi sngon 'gro byings de sgyu lus kyi skabs su bshad pa dang 'dra ba las/ khyad par ni rtsa ba'i bla ma sku dngos su bsgom na yang*/ cha byad ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang*/ stag lpags kyi smad dkris sogs dur khrod kyi chas dang ldan pa zhig bsgom/ ci ste rdo rje 'chang du sgom na yang*/ rdo rje 'chang he ru ka zhi ma khro spyan gsum pa/ sku la dur khrod kyi chas brgyad rdzogs pa zhig bsgom/ gsol 'debs kyi skabs su/ /'od gsal zin par mdzod du gsol/ ces mtha' bsgyur ba'o/ /de rjes su re zhig rang tha mal du gsal ba lta ba'i klad rgya'i steng thod pa'i 'og/spyi bo'i thad der padma dang nyi ma'i gdan sran ma phyed bkas tsam/ de'i steng du gdan de ka dang 'tshams pa'i rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo gri gug thod pa kha ṭwāṃ bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs can sku chung la yan lag dod pa gsal btab/ de'i thugs kar yang a dkar po spu shad kyis bris pa ltar phra ba gsal la 'tsher ba zhig bsgom de las 'od zer 'phros/ thog mar klad pa gti mug gi rang bzhin can de sbyangs/ de nas lus kyi nang gang bas sha khrag rus gsum yang dag ste/

lus 'od lus su gyur par bsam/ de yang yi dam gyi skur bsgoms na ka bzang gsung pas dpal sdom pa lhan skyes su ka bsgom/ der bdag med ma'i thugs ka'i a yig la sems gtad te cung zad bsgom/ de nas a de las 'od zer 'phros/ bdag med ma'i sku gang*/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang lus kyi nang thams cad mun khung du sgraun me btegs pa ltar khra gsal gyis song yang rang gi ba spu'i khung bu nas phar 'phros/ snang ba thams cad khra gsal gyis gsal bar bsam/ tshul de kho nas yang thog mar thugs ka'i a la sems gtod pa dang*/ yang 'od zer spro ba sogs spel gyin bsgom pa las/ thugs ka'i a la sems gtod pa yun ring du bya/ de 'dra lan 'ga' re song ba'i mtshams su/ shes pa rang babs su lhod kyis glod nas gang gnas re bzhag/de lta bu bskyar gyin rtag tu bsgom/ thog ma zhag mang por rtsol ba skyed de de ltar bsgoms pas/ skabs 'gar bde sal le ba rnam rtog med par rang shugs su gnas pa yang dum re 'ong steng re dogs su ma song ba byed/ de 'dra byung na de ka la gang gnas su bzhag pas chog/yang de sangs pa na sngar bzhin 'dun pa drag pos bsgom/ mtshan mo nyal ba'i skabs bdag med ma'i thugs ka'i a la sems gtad de gnyid du 'gro bar bya'o/ / dmigs skor bzhi bcu zhe gsum pa'o/ /gnyis pa a yig la brten pa ni/ sngon 'gro snga ma dang 'dra/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma dkar po sba lcag tsam gsal btab/ de'i nang lte ba'i thad dam lte 'og sor bzhi gang rung du a yig dkar po dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can zhig gsal btab/ a yig de la dar gcig sems bzung*/ a las 'od zer 'phros/ dbu ma'i nang khengs/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang lus kyi nang shin tu gsal bar byas/ rang gi ba spu'i bu ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ snang ba thams cad khra gsal gyis khyab/ nyal ba'i tshe lte 'og gi a la sems gtod/

gzhan ji ltar nyams su len lugs rnams snga ma dang 'dra/ dmigs skor zhe bzhi pa'o/ /gsum pa bla ma la brten te bzung ba ni/ yang sngon 'gro snga ma ltar btang la/ rang lhag pa'i lhar gsal ba'i snying gar padma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang du sgom na rdo rje 'chang sku mdog dkar po spyi dang 'dra ba dang*/ sku dngos su bsgom na yang*/ sku sha mdangs dkar zhing 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba/ zhal 'dzum mul le/ spyan sim me bzhugs pa zhig bsgom/ sku che chung gi tshad kyang che na sor bzhi tsam/ chung na mthe bong gi tshad tsam/ de'i bar ji ltar 'os pa bsgom/ de'i thugs kar thig le dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa'am/ shin tu dkar ba gang bsgoms kyang rung*/ tshad kyang bla ma'i sku la cha dpags nas bya ste/ sku gzugs sor bzhi tsam bsgom na de rgya sran tsam/ sku mthe bong tsam bsgom na/ de sran chung tsam bsgom/ des bar ma rnams la'ang mtshon/ gang ltar na yang bla ma'i thugs ka'i thig le 'od 'phro ba de la sems gtad de cung zad mnyam par bzhag/thugs ka'i thig le las 'od 'phros/ sku khra gsal te khyab/ thugs rgyud bde bas gang*/ sku'i cha thams cad nas 'od zer byung*/ rang lus kyi nang shin tu gsal bar khyab/ rang gi ba spu'i khung bu nas 'od zer 'phros/ snang ba thams cad khra gsal gyis pa bar bsam/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i thig le la 'gyang tsam sems gtad/ de nas 'od zer spro pa'i dmigs pa re byed pa slar nas slar du goms par bya'o/ /nyal ba'i tshe bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūṃ la sems gtad de nyal/ bsgom lugs gzhan rnams snga ma bzhin no/ /dmigs skor zhe lnga pa'o/ /'di 'od gsal 'dzin pa'i dmigs pa'i dngos gzhi gtso bo de yin no/ /rgyu mtshan ni/ /snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo ni/ gnyid 'thug po'i 'khrul ba 'byung ba'i gnas kyi gtso bo yang yin/ de la gnad du bsnun pas lam bsgoms ni/ 'khrul ba de'i gnyen po 'od gsal 'char ba'i gnas kyi yang gtso bo yin pas so/

/'o na gzhan gnyis la'ang gnad de yong 'thad pa la snyam na/ 'di 'dra'i rigs la nges pa med de/ spyir gnyid 'thug po'i 'od gsal 'char ba'i gnas drag shos de snying ga yin kyang*/ thog mar gnas der rlung 'jug dka' ba'i skabs shig/rtsa dbu ma'i gnas gzhan du gnad du bsnun na/ der rlung 'dus pa'i 'od gsal gyi nyams myong zhig 'phral du skye bar 'gyur/ de yang yang goms pa na/ des sna drangs te 'dun pa cung zad bsgyur ba kho nas 'bad rtsol med par snying gar rlung sems 'dus pa'i 'od gsal 'char ba nyid la yang tshegs med do/ /thabs 'di rmi lam sogs gzhan la'ang rigs 'gre'o/ /des na 'od gsal 'dzin pa'i dmigs pa gsum po 'di/ gang blo la bde ba zhig 'bad pas bsgoms nas nus pa thon par bya dgos mod/ gang zag gcig gis gsum khar sgom ma dgos pa rang yang ma yin no/ /gnyis pa 'od gsal lam khyer la/ nyin mo sku gsum lam khyer dang*/ mtshan mo sku gsum rang shar ba/ zhes sa bcad gnyis su byed kyang nyams len dmigs pa gcig kho na ste/ nyin mo sku gsum lam khyer nyid do/ /de yang dang por 'di thun mtshams kyi nyams len gal che ste/ sgyu lus skabs su/ 'dun pa gsum sbrags bshad pa'i dod yin/ de yang rtsa ba mi rtag skyo shas dang*/ gsal bdebs me tog 'char byed du bshad pa bzhin/ 'od gsal gyi thun mtshams su yang*/ mi rtag pa dang*/ bla ma'i mos gus sngar sgyu lus su bshad pa bzhin dgos la/ sgyu lus dang rmi lam la/ sgyu ma dang rmi lam gyi 'dun pa dgos pa'i don/ 'dir sku gsum lam khyer gyi 'jog stangs de dgos pa'i don yin no/ /bsam sdings pa'i khrid yig ni/ thun thun mtshams kyi gsal kha med/ 'jag chen a la sems gtod pa bzhin du grims lhod ran par bya/ zhes gsung ste/ de'i go ba ni a yig gi skabs na rig pa yengs kyang ma yengs bcur bcur du yang ma song ba mnyam rjes thams cad du bsgom gsungs pa de yin pas/

thun thun mtshams gnyis kar du bsgom pa'i don yin/ de la spyir thun gyi skabs su yang 'jog tshul de ka dang mthun pa yin mod kyi/ thun gyi nyams len byed tshul logs su bshad zin pas/ 'dir ni thun mtshams kho na'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /de yang bdag zas za 'gro 'chag/ nyal 'dug spyod lam kun tu sku gsum lam khyer 'di dran pa zhig byed dgos snyam pa'i 'dun pa yang yang btang gin 'gro 'dug sogs bya byed gang byed pa'i skabs der/ gang shar de ka la sems gtad de/ shes pa khong glod/ rang zhal lta shes tsam bya/ de'i tshe mig gi lta stangs kyang ha re bzhag/de yang thog ma thun mtshams yin yang sos dal du 'dug pa'i skabs/ dran pa bsten pa tsam gyis 'phral 'phral du sleb 'ong*/ de nas bya byed brel po kun la'ang rim pas bsre bar bya'o/ /de yang snang ba sna tshogs gang shar ba de'i steng gi gsal cha de gsal ba sprul sku/ rang zhal la cher re bltas pas cir yang ma yin pa de stong pa chos sku/ snang ba sna tshogs pa shar ba la bzo bcos ma byas pa de dang*/ ngos bzung ci yang med pa de sems gsal rig tsam gyi steng de na/ ngo bo dbyer med cig car ro gcig tu shar ba de/ rang rig rang gsal long spyod rdzogs sku lam khyer ro/ /de ltar na thog mar thun mtshams kyi dge sbyor 'di la legs par bslab/ de rjes phal cher la 'di lam du khyer thub pa nas/ skabs 'di'i 'dun pa gsum po gang rung re dran par bya'o/ /mtshan mo sku gsum rang shar ni/ thun gyi skabs su dmigs pa la drag tu bcur ba dang*/ thun mtshams su sku gsum lam khyer bsgoms pa de'i mthu las/ mtshan mo gnyid 'thug po dus su 'od gsal zin pa na/ gsal stong zung 'jug gi sku gsum rang shar du 'byung ngo*/ /gnyid dus kyi gsal ba ni/ snang ba rags pa sna tshogs pa 'di dag de dus mi 'char bas/ rig pa nyid kyi gsal cha dang*/ /'char sgo rtags kyi snang ba sna tshogs pa'o/

/dmigs skor zhe drug pa'o/ /gsum pa bsre ba la/ gsal stong bsre ba dang mnyam rjes bsre ba/ nyin mtshan bsre ba/ bde stong bsre ba ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/ sgom mnyam bzhag gi dus/ sems cir yang ma grub pa 'dra ba de bsgoms pas rkyen byas nas stong sang sang ba ci yang med pa 'dra ba zhig 'char/ thun mtshams su yang gdong gtan kyi dngos po 'di dag gang yang mi 'dug snyam pa 'byung ste/ stong nyams rkyang pa shar ba yin/ skabs der thun dang thun mtshams thams cad du mig nam mkha' la gtad/ rig pa hur phyung*/ stong sang nge ba'i gzhi de la bltas pas/ stong pa de la gsal cha rim gyis rnyed de gsal stong du 'gyur/ yang thun gyi skabs su rnam rtog med pa la rig pa gsal seng nge dga' bde dang bcas pa 'byung ba/ thun mtshams su'ang de la sred pa che/ rang rtsis skye bar 'dug na/ gsal ba rkyang pa'i nyams skyes pa yin pas/ thun thun mtshams thams cad du sems dwangs sang nge ba/ gsal rjen ne ba/ de'i ngo bo la lta gzhigs drag tu bcug pas thogs pa'i dngos po zhig pa ltar chems se song nas ngos bzung du med pa zhig 'ong*/ de'i ngang la bzo bcos med par bzhag/sems la bltas nas kyang sgyu ma lta bu'o zhes yang yang dran pa gsal stong du 'char te/ de ltar na gsal ba stong pa la bsre ba'o/ /dmigs skor zhe bdun pa'o/ /gnyis pa mnyam rjes bsre ba ni/ spyir rjes thob mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig yin na/ mnyam bzhag dang ched du bsre mi dgos kyang*/ 'dir thun la mnyam bzhag dang*/ thun mtshams tsam po la rjes thob ces btags pa'o/ /de yang thun gyi skabs su rtsol bas bcos pa ma yin par sems gsal stong du dum re gnas pa yang yang byung kyang*/ thun mtshams su dang po'i tha mal pa zang ma de ka ma gtogs/ gsal stong gi nyams ye mi sleb pa 'dug na/ thun gyi skabs su nyams cung zad shar ba'i dus der/ spyod lam gang yang rung ba zhig la bsre ba'i 'dun pa gtong ste/

dper na/ da ltar bdag skor ba byed pa'i skabs su/ nyams 'di bskyang bar bya snyam pa'i 'dun pa yang yang btang*/ thun las langs pa'i skabs su yang de ka'i rgyun dran pas bzung*/ lag tu 'chang rgyu lta bur dran 'dzin gyi rtags shig kyang bzhag/de nas skor ba byed pa'i skabs su/ sku gsum lam khyer du bshad pa bzhin dang de bskyangs pas/ thun gyi skabs su bshad pa lta bu'i gsal stong gi nyams de sleb 'ong*/ de ltar zhag 'ga' re song na rtsol ba chen po mi dgos par 'ong ste/ de la goms nas spyod lam gzhan thams cad la'ang rim pas sbyang*/ 'di ni mnyam bzhag gi nyams myong rjes thob la bsre ba yin/ rjes thob mnyam bzhag la tshur bsre ba ni mi dgos/ 'ga' zhig la rjes thob kyi nyams myong bzang po shar nas/ des mnyam bzhag la bogs 'thon pa zhig 'ong ste/ de shugs 'byung la 'og gi bcos pas mi phan no/ /dmigs skor zhe brgyad pa'o/ /gsum pa nyin mtshan bsre ba ni/ nyin mo thun gyi skabs la gsal stong gi nyams shar yang*/ mtshan mo gnyid 'thug po'i skabs su ye ma slebs na/ thun gyi skabs su dmigs pa gsum po gang rung zhig la brten nas/ rlung bum pa can bsgom zhing rig pa drag tu bzhur/ gsal stong gi nyams shar ba'i dus/ do nub gnyid kyi dus su'ang 'di kho na ltar bsgom rgyu yin snyam pa bag tsam re 'dun pa btang gin/ thun mtshams su yang snga dro 'dun pa cung zad bya/ dgongs mo dang srod kyi thun mtshams la/ 'dun pa drag tu sbyong ba gal che/ nyal khar yang 'jam rlung khug pa kha re bzung zhing dmigs pa bsgom/ mthar rang gi lus dang sems la sems gtad de cher re bzhag pa'i ngang nas gnyid du 'gro bar bya/ des nges par gnyid kyi dge sbyor zin 'ong ngo*/ /yang 'ga' zhig la mtshan mo'i dge sbyor bzang po thog mar skyes nas/ nyin par nyams myong de dran pa tsam gyis nyin par gyi dge sbyor la bogs 'byin par byed pa zhig kyang yod de/

'di yang rang shugs la 'byung ba ka yin no/ /'od gsal la ni de lta bu dgos pa ci rigs pa 'byung la/ rmi lam rtsal sbyong la ni/ mtshan mo'i nyin mo la ched gtad bogs 'byin dgos pa yang shin tu mang ngo*/ /dmigs skor zhe dgu pa'o/ /bzhi pa bde stong dbyer med du bsre ba ni/ sems gsal ba dang*/ stong pa dang*/ mi rtog pa'i nyams kyis drangs pa'i dga' ba de la nyams bde ba chen po 'byung yang*/ ched du gnyer nas stong par bsre ba mi dgos/ gsal ba nyid sgyu ma lta bur shes pas rang chod la 'gro/ /zhu bde'i nyams rnams stong par bsre dgos pa yin te/ gzhan lus shes rab kyi bde ba'am/ rang lus thabs ldan gtum mo'ang*/ sgyu lus dbang po tha ma lta bu'am/ thig le dbang bzhi'i gnad dam/ 'od gsal 'dzin pa'i dmigs pa gsum lta bu bsgoms pas/ rlung dbu mar thim pa'i bde drod skyes pa lta bu la bsre dgos pa yin te/ de yang bde nyams lan re tsam byung 'phral la bsre ba skad byas na/ nyams de sangs 'gro bas mi bya la/ de yang yang 'ong zhing brtan po yod na bsre dgos/ /nga rgyal dang sred zhen mngon gyur pa med na/ de'i rang zhal brtas pa tsam gyis bde bar snang ba ma 'gags bzhin du/ ngos bzung med par lhod de shigs se song ba de ka bskyangs pas chog/sred zhen dang rlom sems skye na/ bde ba de nyid la sgyu ma lta bur 'dun pa sbyangs shing*/ mthar sgyu 'dzin dang bral ba'i phyag rgya chen po la bzhag na/ bde stong dbyer med du 'gyur ro/ /bsre ba bzhi po de dag thams cad kyi gnas skabs su/ thun mtshams spyod lam gang byed kyang*/ yang nas yang du gang shar de la glang po che'i lta stangs kyis had de chad de 'jog pa kho na dgos/ mnyam bzhag gi dus su yang rtog med kyi nyams bde gsal gang shar dang*/ rtog bcas dmigs pa la gnad du bsnun pa'i dus thams cad du yang de ka ltar 'jog pa gnad du che/ lar thun thun mtshams su bde sdug mtho dman 'jig rten chos brgyad thams cad la sgyu ma lta bur shes pas/

da lta 'jig rten pa'i bzang ngan mtho dman nye ring gi rnam bzhag skad skad po 'di'i a 'thas zhig pa rang gal che'o/ /dmigs skor lnga bcu pa'o/ /bzhi pa mthar thug ni/ dang por nyin mo dang mtshan mo'i 'od gsal gang la'ang*/ 'od gsal gyi rtogs pa skye ba'i dang por gsal stong dbyer med kyi 'od gsal 'byung*/ tshogs lam gyi thad yin/ de nas bde stong dbyer med kyi 'od gsal 'byung*/ sbyor lam gyi thad yin/ de nas zab zhi spros bral gyi 'od gsal 'byung*/ ma dag sa bdun gyi thad sor sleb/ de nas dbyer med mthar thug gi 'od gsal 'byung*/ dag pa sa gsum gyi skabs yin/ de rjes dag pa gnyis ldan gyi 'od gsal te/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa ye shes chos sku'o/ /'di dag gi don rgyas par bshad na mang mod kyi 'dir ma spros so/ /'di ni spyir 'od gsal zhes bya ba gnas lugs kyi don rtogs tshul la sa mtshams phye ba yin/ gnyid kyi 'od gsal gcig po'i dbye ba ma yin no/ /'di la dmigs pa logs pa med pas dmigs skor du mi bgrang*/ chos thun gcig lta bu ji ltar 'os pa'o/ /gsum pa rjes kyi khrid la/ dam tshig spyi dang bye brag/gegs sel nyes skyon rang dgabogs 'don the tshom gcod byed/ khyad 'phags 'char sgo ngos 'dzin/ nyams rtogs nyin mtshan khyad par te/ lnga las/ dang po ni/ spyir sdom gsum las rang gis gang blangs pa'i bslab bya rnams ma nyams pa gal che/ nyes ltung can la sgom rnam par dag pa mi skye zhing*/ sngar skyes rnams kyang nyes ltung byung na nyams 'gro bas so/ /de'i nang nas kyang gsang sngags kyi dam tshig ma nyams pa rtsa ba yan lag gi ltung bas ma gos pa dgos te/ dam tshig de dag nyams na sgom gyi re ba lta zhog/'di dang phyi mar mtho ris kyi bde ba tsam yang med te/ ngan song gsum la zang thal du 'gro bas so/ /de dag spyi'i dam tshig yin la/ gzhan mnyam rjes kyi dam tshig mtha' dag sgrub nus na der yang 'dus/

'on kyang dam bca' 'chag med yin yin po'i bya spyod kyi rim pa mang pos sems 'khrug par yang mi byed de/ nyams len dang 'bral med kyi ngang nas/ bla ma'i mos gus dang ma bral ba/ rten kun de byang sems ma nyams pa/ tha mal chags sdang gi yul snang thams cad sgyu ma lta bur bsgoms nas/ chags sdang gi dbang du mi gtong ba rnams 'od gsal sgos kyi dam tshig go /'dir 'od gsal ces bya ba yang*/ chos drug gi nang tshan mtshan mo'i 'od gsal kho nar ma zad/ nyin mtshan gyi 'od gsal thams cad yin pas/ bsre ba sgyu lus spyi khyab la go bar bya la/ 'pho ba bar do'ang bsre ba'i yan lag yin pa'i phyir/ dam tshig 'di ni dam tshig spyi 'gro yin no/ /gnyis pa gegs sel nyes skyon rang dag ni/ spyir thabs lam dang 'brel ba gegs sel gyi yi ge sna tshogs pa ni gzhan du gsal la/ 'dir gsal stong 'dzin med/ snang stong rang shar/ bde stong zhen bral rnams nyams myong gi ye shes yin pa la/ de rnams kyi mi mthun phyogs kyi bdud ni/ 'dzin pa rnam rtog rang ga mar shor ba 'di yin pas/ rnam rtog gi rang zhal bltas nas rang grol rang dag rang stong du ngo 'phrod par bsgom/ de yang rnam rtog sems yin/ sems skye med mtha' dang bral ba'i gnad kas gang shar la bzo bcos med par bltas pas 'char sgo'i rang tshugs zhig/snang ba dang stong pa ris su ma chad pa'i rang 'gros la 'jog pa dang*/ yang skabs 'gar 'char sgo sna tshogs pa'i snang ba dang rig pa thams cad sgyu ma lta bus shes pa'i 'dun pa drag pos ar la gtad te bzhag go /de gnyid kho nas gegs dang gol sa sdug bsngal thams cad las grol bar 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa bogs 'don the tshom gcod byed ni/ kha cig rang gi nyams myong la the tshoms med par nges shes thag chod kyi bogs 'don yang gsung*/ 'ga' zhig tshad med gnyis kyis bogs 'don yang gsung*/ de las kyang 'di ltar bya ste/ khyad par du snang ba sna tshogs dang*/

bde sdug chags sdang gi yul rnams kyi steng du/ sgyu lus rmi lam gyi 'dun pa'i rtsal sbyong dang*/ mi rtog pa rnams hur thon pa sbyong ba dang*/ gnas nges med/ 'dug stangs nges med/ 'gro sdod spyod lam nges pa med pa la yang 'dun pa gang rung re shugs bskyed de yang yang bsgom pa rnams phyi'i bogs 'don yin/ rlung sems 'jur la 'debs pa'i thabs rtsa rlung gi sbyor ba drag po shi med ko med du gzir ba skabs skabs su bsgom pa nang gi bogs 'don yin/ bogs 'don gnyis po de 'dra re'i mthar rig pa'i rtsal chen po re 'ong bas/ de la thag chod kyi nges shes bskyed/ de bla ma'i bka' drin du shes nas gsol ba 'debs/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje re bsgom pa lags/ bogs 'don dgos na de la mdzod/ bzhi pa khyad 'phags 'char sgo ngos 'dzin ni/ rgyas par logs su ston pa'i phyir skabs 'dir rgyas bshad mi dgos mod/ 'on kyang 'di skad ces gsal ba'i 'char sgo/ mi rtog pa'i 'char sgo/ bde ba'i 'char sgo/ zung 'jug gi 'char sgo ste bzhi yod lags/ dang po ni/ 'od gsal nyams kyi gsal cha la gnyid dus su rtags snang dang*/ lus nyams/ sems nyams sna tshogs su 'char ba zhig yin/ gnyis pa ni/ rna bar tsi rong ba dang*/ thibs thibs pa dang*/ 'jig 'jir gnon pa'o/ /rlung sems dbu mar chud pa yin/ yang 'dar ba dang*/ 'phar ba dang*/ brgyal ba dang*/ yan lag phral song ba'ang*/ rtsa mdud grol ba yin/ gzhan yang rnam shes nam mkha' la yal pa 'dra ba 'ong*/ mi rtog pa gsal snang chen po la 'dar yer pa 'dra ba'ang 'ong*/ de dag la dga' spro dang*/ rlom sems byung na dge sbyor la bogs mi thon/ nad gdod kyi rnam 'gyur yin par bzung na gegs su 'gro bas/ dga' mi dga' med par byung rgyal du bskyang*/ gsum pa ni/ lus sems bde gsal du 'char ba yin/ bzhi pa ni nyid mtshan thams cad du 'bad rtsol med par 'od gsal 'char ba la zer ro/

/rtsa ba'i lnga pa nyams rtogs nyin mtshan khyad par ni/ de yang lha sku dang thig le sogs blos bcos shing gsar du bsgom pa'i skabs der/ gsal mi gsal ji ltar byung yang 'od gsal yang min la lha sku rang shar yang min no/ /rig pa bsgribs te bzhag pa'i skabs der rtsol ba'i 'dun rtog dang bcas pa bzhin du/ sems bag re gnas pa dang*/ bde gsal gyi nyams yod pa snyam byed pa zhig 'byung ste/ de tsam zhig gnyid sad kyi gnas skabs gang la byung kyang 'od gsal dngos ni ma yin/ 'od gsal gyi rgyur 'gro ba tsam ni yin no/ /des na thun thun mtshams gang la yin kyang*/ kho rang gi skabs der ched gtad rtsol ba ma byas par rang shar ba'i sems gsal stong bde ba mi rtog pa shar ba de la 'od gsal zer/ nyin mtshan gang la byung kyang khyad med do/ /yang kho ra'i dus de na bskyed 'dod kyi blo drag po mngon gyur med kyang*/ rang dang phyi rol du lha sku lam lam shar yod na/ sgyu lus lha sku rang shar zhes bya ba yin/ sad dus dang rmi lam la khyad med/ nged sgom chen pa'i glen gtam mam/ ri la sdug khur 'dra byas pa'i sdug yus tsam lags mod/ rgyud sde mkhan po dang mkhas pa rnams bkyon te mchi/ rang sa na blo gtad thub pa re myong thog na bdog/bka' bkyon kyang skrag rgyu tsam mi gda'/ bsgom nus na rang re las dang po pa mkhas rmongs kun la yang dka' tshegs chen po rang yang mi dgos/ yun ring dgug sdod rang yang mi dgos par 'ong*/ rkyen 'byung dus su'ang cung zad sleb 'ong*/ sems la'ang phan pas 'phral bde zhing skyid par yang 'ong*/ sa lam mthon po'i sgyu lus dang*/ 'od gsal zung 'jug gi rnam bzhag tsam de rang re las dang po pas lag len du khel ba min/ da lta lag len du khel ba 'di rnams ka mthar de dag gi rgyu grung por 'gro ba yin/ myu gu chung ngu nas legs par bskyangs pas mthar ston thog 'ong ba dang 'dra'o/

/de lta bu'i 'od gsal la/ nyams kyi 'od gsal dang*/ rtogs pa'i 'od gsal gnyis yod/ de gnyis ka la nyin mo sad dus kyi 'od gsal dang*/ mtshan mo gnyid dus kyi 'od gsal gnyis su dbye bas bzhi ru song*/ bzhi ga la snang bcas dang*/ snang med gnyis gnyis su phye bas brgyad du 'gyur/ snang bcas bzhi la phyi dang 'brel ba bzhi dang*/ ma 'brel ba bzhi ste brgyad/ snang med bzhi la'ang*/ srab mo'i 'od gsal dang*/ 'thug po'i 'od gsal gnyis gnyis te brgyad/ de thams cad bsdoms pa bcu drug go /slob ma nyams myong shar ba yin na/ de dag gi ngos 'dzin zhib par bshad la/ khong rang la shar ba'i 'od gsal gang yin pa de ngo sprad do/ / slob ma nyams myong ma shar ba dang*/ sna tshogs 'dus pa'i tshogs pa la/ /bcu drug dbye ba'i ming tsam ka bshad pa de kas chog go /de ltar na bsre ba dang*/ mthar thug dang*/ rjes kyi chos lnga po 'di dag chos drug nang sel gyi 'od gsal gyi sa bcad du sdud yod kyang*/ don la gtum mo/ sgyu lus/ rmi lam/ 'od gsal bzhi char gyi khrid bskyangs zin pa'i rjes skyong ba'i khrid yin par shes so/ /rjes kyi chos 'di rnams la nyams len dmigs pa'i gnad gal che ba mang po 'dug kyang*/ phyis rim pas bsgom rgyu'i gdams ngag yin pas/ da lta 'phral khyer gyi dmigs skor du bcad pa ni mi mdzad pas/ chos mthun mang nyung ji tsam byed skabs dang sbyar ro/ /de ltar na de dag ni rtsa ba'i chos bzhi zhes kyang bya/ bsre ba sgyu lus zhes kyang bya ste/ bsre ba dang 'pho ba zhes pa la/ rje mar pa lo tsā'i gdams ngag so so rnams na/ bsre ba'i rnam bzhag mi 'dra ba mang po yod kyang 'dir mi 'chad/ gdams ngag 'di nyid kyi lugs la/ gong du bshad pa gsal stong bsre ba sogs bsre ba bzhi dang*/ gzhan yang bsre 'pho shes rab rnam bzhi'am rnam gsum zhes grags pa yin/ de la shes rab gsum ni/ log par shes pa'i shes rab/

kun rdzob shes pa'i shes rab/ don dam shes pa'i shes rab bo/ /de yang thabs khyad par can gyis bsgrubs pa'i bde ba chen po'i dbang du byas na/ dang por bde bar shar tsam na zag bcas chags pa'i blo zhig kyang 'dug pa de phyin ci log shes pa yin/ de rang du sems sgyu ma lta bu'i bde bar shar ba de kun rdzob shes pa yin pas/ log pa de kun rdzob shes pa'i shes rab la bsre ba yin/ de yang bzo med dbyings su shar ba de don dam shes pa yin te/ kun rdzob de don dam shes pa'i shes rab la bsre ba yin/ gang shar thams cad kyi steng du dbyings shar de ngos bzung de ye shes dang cir snang ba bsre ba yin/ de mtshon nas sad dus kyi snang ba bun long shar ba tsam 'di log pa'i shes pa/ de sgyu mar shar ba kun rdzob shes pa/ sgyu mar 'dzin pa dang bral ba'i rang 'gros de don dam shes pa/ de gang shar gyi steng du khyer ba de ye shes dang cir snang bsre ba'o/ /yang rmi lam shar tsam de log pa/ de rmi lam dang sgyu mar shes pa kun rdzob/ rgyu 'dzin bral ba don dam/ de gnyid sad sogs kun tu khyer ba de ye shes dang cir snang bsre ba'o/ /gnyid 'thug po dran med du med du thibs song ba de log pa/ de la bde gsal du dran pa sleb pa de kun rdzob/ de rang bzhin bzo med du 'dug pa don dam/ des sad dus dang rmi lam rgyas thebs pa de ye shes dang cir snang dbyer med do/ /shes rab bzhir byed pa ltar na ye shes cir snang dbyer med la/ zung 'jug shes pa'i shes rab bcas ming 'dogs/ sgyu lus rmi lam skabs kyi rang shar lha sku ni kun rdzob don dam zung 'jug gsum kha'i cha ru yod gsung*/ yang thabs lam gyi bde ba sgyu lus dang bsre/ 'od gsal gyi bde stong rmi lam dang bsre/ sgyu lus dang rmi lam phan tshun du bsre zhes kyang gsung ste/ bsre ba'i don dbyer med du lam du khyer ba'i don lags pas so/

/gzhan yang bsre ba'i gzhi gnas thabs bshad na/ skabs 'dir 'di dag go dgos te/ 'khor ba pa rnams kyi 'khrul ba thams cad bsdu na bzhi ste/ gnyid sad dus dang*/ gnyid 'thug po dang*/ rmi lam dang*/ gnyis sbyor gyi chags rtog ste bzhi po der 'dus/ bzhi po de gzhi chos dbyings kyi sku gsung thugs bde ba chen po bzhi la sgrib pa yin/ lam gyi ye shes snang stong dang*/ rig stong dang*/ gsal stong dang*/ bde stong bzhi pos rim gyis sgrib pa de rnams sel ba yin/ 'di'i skabs kyi rig stong ni mi rtog pa la zer/ de dag gi gtso bo yang rim pas sgyu lus dang*/ 'od gsal dang*/ rmi lam dang*/ gtum mo rnams yin/ de rnams bsgoms pa las 'bras bu mthar thug ni/ sprul sku/ chos sku/ longs sku/ bde chen gyi sku ste/ sku bzhi mngon du 'gyur ro/ /yang ye shes lnga dang sbyor na/ sgyu lus me long lta bu/ 'od gsal mnyam pa nyid/ rmi lam so sor rtog pa/ gtum mo chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes sgrub pa'i lam yin bsrung bar thams cad 'dra la/ bya grub ni chos bzhi char gyi 'bras bu spyi la sbyor gsung ba dang*/ sor rtog bya grub gnyis kar rmi lam la sbyor gsung ba'ang 'dug ste man ngag gsung rgyun las/ las rgya bya grub kyi lam du 'chad/ 'on kyang thams cad la mi 'gal lo/ /lnga pa 'pho ba ma bsgoms sangs rgyas la/ gzhung gi 'pho ba dang*/ lhan thabs kyi man ngag gnyis yod pa las/ dang po la/ gzhung las/ chos sku de bzhin nyid kyi 'pho ba/ zung 'jug yi dam gyi 'pho ba/ byin rlabs bla ma'i 'pho ba/ 'chug med mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba'o/ /dang po ni/ 'chi ba 'od gsal ma bu ngo 'phrod na/ gzhan rnams la 'chi srid 'byung rgyu de/ rnal 'byor pa la 'od gsal bde stong du rang shar bas gong du 'pho ba'i gdams ngag la ma ltos te/ dus de nyid du rang grol ba'o/ /'di la dmigs pa logs pa med pas dmigs skor la mi bgrang ngo*/

/gnyis pa zung 'jug yi dam gyi 'pho ba ni/ sngon 'gro rnams sngar sgyu lus skabs dang 'dra ba las/ bar dor sangs rgyas pa mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsol 'debs kyi mtha' bsgyur ba tsam gyi khyad par ro/ /rang lhar gsal ba'i spyi bo'i steng gi nam mkha' la rang gang mos pa'i yi dam de bsgom gsung*/ spyir de ltar yin yang des khrigs ma byas na/ mi blun po'i yi dam la tshad gzung mi yong bas/ skabs 'dir 'khor lo sdom pa'am/ dgyes mdzad gang rung zhig rang gi spyi bo'i mda' gang tsam gyi steng gi nam mkha' la bsgom/ rang gi lus kyi dbus su dbu ma kha dog dkar ba sngar bshad pa rnams dang 'dra ba la/ mar sna gsang bar zug pa kha zum pa/ yar sna spyi bo tshangs bug la reg pa/ spyi bo tshangs bug te/ dbu ma'i kha dang rgya khyon mnyam pa/ rgya mthongs kha bye ba bzhin du skya thal le yod pa zhig bsgom/ dbu ma'i nang lte bar rang sems a dkar po dang*/ mas snar yi dam gyi sa bon hūṃ sngon po rlung gi rang bzhin zhig gsal btab*/ de mtshams rlung ro bsal nas 'jam rlung bag tsam bzung*/ lte ba'i a dang gsang ba'i hūṃ la sems drag tu gtad/ yang rlung phyir bsal ba'i dus/ kha nas 'bud na hig ring po dang*/ sna nas 'bud na hūṃ ring byed dam sgra med kyi tshul gyis rlung shugs bkyed de bsal/ der skabs mas sna'i hūṃ shugs dang ldan pa des lte ba'i a yar khyer te/ yi ge nyis brtsegs de dbu ma'i lam nas brgyud/ spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga nas rgyangs te thon te yi dam gyi thugs kar sleb/ der gang yang mi bsam par dran med thabs su cung zad bzhag/skabs der rlung yang rang babs so/ /de lta bu bskyar gyin lan bdun tsam bsgom/ de rjes yi dam gyi thugs ka nas yi ge nyis brtsegs thur la rgyang gis byung*/ spyi bo nas zhugs dbu ma'i lam nas brgyud de song*/ a yig lte bar bsdad/ hūṃ yig gsang bar song ste ljid dang ldan par bsam/

dmigs pa thun chung gcig go /de ltar yang yang bsgom/ thun 'jog khar yig 'bru gnyis po sngar bzhin ma phab pa'i rjes la/ yi dam 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ hūm̐ sngon po las 'phros pa'i 'od kyi kha gcod lta bus spyi bo'i tshangs bug 'grig por bkag par bsam/ de nyid 'pho ba'i rtags byung byung gi bar du bsgom/ de nas kyang nyin rer dmigs pa lan re tsam bsgom mo/ /dmigs skor nga gcig pa'o/ /gsum pa byin rlabs bla ma'i 'pho ba ni/ sngon 'gro snga ma dang 'dra/ dngos gzhi'i skabs su yang rtsa dbu ma sngar bzhin bsgom/ dbu ma'i nang lte bar thig le dkar po gsung ba dang*/ ser po gsung ba sogs ci rigs yod kyang*/ lag len du dkar la ser ba'i mdangs chags pa 'od 'phro ba/ nor bu ke ke ru dang 'dra ba/ zlum zhing 'gril ba bongs tshod sran rdog tsam zhig gsal 'debs/ rlung sbyor yang snga ma dang 'dra/ thig le dkar ser de spyi gtsug nas yar rgyang thon te/ bla ma'i thugs kar thim de ltar dmigs pa bskyar gyin lan bdun song ba na/ mar 'bebs pa'i dmigs pa byed de/ lte bar thig le ljid dang ldan pa nyams bde ba zhig bsgom/ de lta bu thun chung gcig ste de nyid bskyar gyin bsgom/ thun 'jog khar rlung sems lte bar phab pa'i rjes su/ bla ma la mos gus dung ba byas pas bla ma 'od du zhu/ spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs te thim pas lus sems bde bas khyab/ spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga de yang thig le dkar po gcig gi bkag par bsam/ tshul de lta bur rtags byung byung bsgom/ de ltar 'pho ba de gnyis ka la yang las la sbyor ba'i skabs/ yar 'pho ba 'ba' zhig bsgom gyi mar 'bebs pa mi dgos la/ thun mtshams su sgo bkag pa yang mi dgos so/ /dmigs skor nga gnyis pa'o/ /bzhi pa 'chug med mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba ni/ spyir dkyus kyi man ngag gi bsdebs yin kyang shin tu bka' gnyan ces gsung nas bka' rgya can du mdzad de tshogs su mi gsung*/

de bas na logs su shes par bya'o/ /dkyus kyi sa bcad kyis bsdus pa ma yin kyang*/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma nyid kyi gsung 'pho ba bsdus pa gzhan yang rigs lnga tsam yod do/ /gnyis pa lhan thabs kyi man ngag ni/ skabs 'dir/ gzhung nas 'pho ba mang po bshad kyang*/ lag len ye shes skar khung ma la byed gsung*/ gzhung 'pho rnams la'ang lag len ye mi mdzad pa yin mod/ 'di la phyag len gtso cher mang du 'debs pa la dgongs pa'o/ / 'di la sbyang ba dang las la sbyar ba gnyis yod/ dang po sbyang ba ni/ sngon 'gro sngar dang 'dra/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pa'i rjes su/ rang lus lha sku khong stong du bsam/ rtsa dbu ma yang yid dam gyi 'pho ba'i skabs su bshad pa bzhin bsgom/ dbu ma'i nang lte ba'i thad du chos 'byung gru gsum dkar po/ rtsa ba phra ba thur bstan/ gdengs ka gyen bstan/ zur gcig mdun la bstan pa/ rgyab gzhung gi ngos la logs gcig bstan par bsgom/ de'i dbus su rten gang la yang ma reg pa'i a yig dkar po/ sran chung ngam/ yungs 'bru'i tshad gsal 'debs/ tshad che chung ma gtogs chos 'byung dang a yig gi bzhugs tshul stong ra'i skabs dang 'dra/ de rjes rlung ro bsal/ rlung bum can shugs drag po yun thung tsam cig bzung*/ lte ba'i a la sems drag tu gtad/ rlung bzung ba'i ngang de ka nas lto ba tshigs pa'i phyogs la cung zad gcer tsam dang*/ a dkar po de 'phar tsam byung nas yang sngar shul du bsdad/ de bas cung shugs che bas gcer ba na/ yang sngar las mtho tsam 'phar ba las sngar gyi sar bsdad/ yang de 'phral skad cig la drag tu gcer te thub tshad du bsdad pas/ rlung stong du khong gis 'gril yong*/ dmigs pa chos 'byung gi kha thag gis brdabs pas/ de rlung gis bdas pa bzhin du rang sems a dkar po de mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du dbu ma'i lam brgyud spyi bo tshangs bug nas thon/ /nam mkha' la ye re re song*/ dbyings mthon po mthon por slebs nas nam mkha' la yal bar bsams te/

dbyings dang nam mkha' rig pa gsum dbyer med du 'dres pa la hud de bzhag /dmigs pa de lta bu bskyar gyin lan bdun tsam bsgom/ yang 'bebs pa ni nam mkha'i dbus su a dkar po zhig lam te grub/ de mar bab pa spyi bo tshangs bug nas zhugs/ dbu ma'i nang nas mar lam lam lam dal bus babs/ lte ba'i chos 'byung gi dbus su brtan cing brjid dang ldan pa'i tshul gyis sgring nge 'dug par bsam de thun chung gcig yin/ de ltar yang yang bsgom/ thun chen re'i nang du thun chung nge 'dra nyer gcig gam/ bcu gcig gam bdun tsam re byed/ de lta bu'i thun bzhi'am drug sogs byas na rtags myur du 'ong ste/ rtsol ba che chung gi rim pas zhag bdun nam/ zla phyed dam/ zla gcig tsam la rtags rab 'bring tha ma gsum gang rung zhig 'byung bar the tshom med do/ /de yang rtags rab spyi bo 'bur ba brdol te chu ser sogs byung na'ang yin/ dmigs pa btang res kyi ltag pa'i rtsa gnyis rengs shing*/ mig sbrid chil ba dang*/ dran med du 'gro tshad pa byung na yin/ 'bring ni spyi bo 'bur ba tsam dang*/ mdun rtse chung gi rtsa rgyangs pa lta bu'o/ /tha ma spyi bo za zhing 'gul la 'khrigs pa 'ong*/ des mi yong gong ma gnyis gang rung gcig rang dgos/ gsung*/ dmigs pa gsal shos gcig la 'di bsgom tsam na yun ring du dran med du brgyal ba 'byung ste/ de la rin po che'i snod byang mas spyi gtsug bkab na/ thal ba'i nyes pa mi 'byung gsung*/ 'on kyang de 'dra'i rigs la tshigs pa brdung ba dang 'bebs kyis phab na legs so/ /de ltar rtags byung nas nyin re bzhin dmigs pa tshar re bsgom dgos/ spyir da lta 'pho bas rtsa lam 'byongs na/ nam zhig 'chi tshe 'pho ba'i gsal 'debs med kyang*/ sngar rtsa sgo bye zhing rtsa lam byang ba de nyid nas phal cher 'gro yang re re tsam ma nges pa las gsal 'debs byung na 'chug pa med/ sgom 'phro bzhag nas yun ring lon na/

dgos dus gsal mi thebs pa yang srid pas/ da lta sbyangs pa'i rgyun mi nyams pa'i phyir thun re bsgom pa yin/ lhag ma sgyu lus sogs bsgom pa khe che'o/ /las la sbyar ba ni sngar bshad pa dang 'dra ste/ myur du 'chi ba'i rtags nges pa can byung na/ yo byad la ma chags par bya/ rang gang mos pa la mchod 'bul dang*/ sbyan gtong byed/ khon dang sel yod pa rnams la dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas bshags sbyang bya/ nye du sogs la chags pa'i blo spangs te/ 'brel thag bcad nas bsgom dgos so/ /'dir rdzas kyi 'pho ba'ang bshad pa 'grub na ni legs/ med ka med ni min no/ /dmigs skor nga gsum pa'o/ /de yang chad la gtum mo'i skabs su rtsa dbu ma dmar por bsgom/ gzhan rnams la'ang phyi dkar nang dmar sogs khrid yig rnams su mi 'dra ba ci rigs bshad kyang lag len du dkar po kho na mdzad/ ye shes skar khung ma la chos 'byung gi stabs dbu ma cung zad sbom par bsgom dgos/ thig le dbang bzhi'i gnad la'ang de dang 'dra/ chos 'byung yang phyi dkar nang dmar sogs ci rigs bshad mod de/ bar do'i skabs ma gtogs/ chos drug gzhung gi dmigs pa'i chos 'byung thams cad dkar po kho nar mdzad pa zhal rgyun yin/ thabs lam dang 'od gsal gyi skabs na lus thams cad dbu mas khyab par bsgom lus re yig rnying kun na bshad mod kyang*/ las dang po pa'i skabs na de rang phan chung mi dgos gsung ste khrid kyi dkyus la mi mdzad do/ /drug pa bar do rgyal ba longs sku ni rnam pa bzhi ste/ rab bar do dang po'i 'od gsal chos sku rang shar/ 'bring rgyal ba longs sku rang shar/ tha ma sprul sku 'gag med rang shar/ spyir gnad 'chug med kyi gdams ngag ste/ sa bcad bzhi yod la/ de'i dang po ni/ gong 'pho bya 'pho byed dang bral ba dang don gcig ste/ de yang bar do dang po zhes pa ni/ 'od gsal ma bu 'dres pa'i ye shes 'chi sems bde stong 'od gsal du gnas gyur pa de yin te/

bar do'i dang por byung bas so/ /de la 'chi ba chos sku zhes bya/ de las langs pa na tha mal pa rnams la bar do 'byung ba'i dod la lha sku sgyu ma lta bu rang shar du 'byung ba de la 'od gsal rang shar zer/ 'od gsal las rang shar ba'i go ba yin no/ /de yang sad dus su bde stong dang lha sku rgyun mi 'chad/ gnyid 'thug po thams cad 'od gsal du chugarmi lam gyi rtsal sbyong zad pa yang med la dag snang lha skur rang shar ba'i gang zag de la bar do dang po'i 'od gsal rang shar chos sku 'di 'byung ba yin no/ /'di la dmigs pa logs pa med/ skabs 'dir de dag gi rnam bzhag rgyas par 'chad 'dod na chos thun gcig gnyis sogs ji ltar 'os pa byed/ gnyis pa 'bring rgyal ba longs sku rang shar ni/ sngon 'gro babs sgyu lus dang 'dra ba las/ bar do longs sku thob par mdzad du gsol ces mtha' bsgyur/ bla ma rang la thim pa'i rjes su/ rang dang snang ba thams cad la bltas te/ srid pa bar do dngos yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa yang drag po sbyangs/ 'gro drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/ chags sdang nyon mongs kyi nyes dmigs dran pa'i skyo shas drag po yang bya/ bar do'i skabs 'dir/ 'khrul na 'khrul tshabs che ste chags sdang gi rnam rtog re res kyang skad cig la dmyal bar yang bskyur rung*/ lam bsgoms na grol tshabs kyang che ste/ da lta sad dus su lo zlar bsgoms pa las kyang*/ 'dir dar cig re bsgoms pa yang bogs dang chod che ba yin/ da nyon mongs kyi dbang du mi gtong bar ma 'khrul ba zhig byed dgos/ bla mas gnang ba'i rgyal ba longs sku bsgom par bya snyam du bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du chos 'byung sngon po rtsa ba phra zhing gdengs kha gyen du bstan pa zhig bsgom/ 'dir rang bzhin ma rtogs pa rnams la ma'i mngal du 'dug/ rtogs pa rnams la 'og min chos kyi pho brang rang yin ang snyam du bsam par bya/ de nas rang nyid de'i dbus su phyin/

rang sems hūṃ yig sngon po che zhing 'od 'bar ba zhig tu gyur/ de las 'od 'phros chos 'byung la phog/'das pa'i mngal skyes kyi lan chags dang bag chags thams cad sbyangs/ da ltar ba'i mngal skyes kyi las thams cad kyang dag/ma 'ongs pa skye bar 'gyur ba'i sgo bkag/skye gnas gzhan gsum gyi bag chags rnams zhor la rang dag par bsam/ bar do yin ang snyam hūṃ de yongs su gyur pa las rang skad cig gis 'khor lo bde mchog lhan skyes su bsgom/ bar do yin ang snyam spyi bor gdan bzhi rdzogs kyi steng du bla ma bsgom/ bar do'i skabs 'dir longs sku thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes rtse gcig tu gsol ba btab/ de ltar dmigs pa sgom pa'i skabs thams cad du bar do rang yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa rgyun chags gal che/ dmigs skor nga bzhi pa'o/ /gsum pa tha ma sprul sku 'gag med rang shar ni/ dmigs pa snga ma de rdzogs par bsgoms nas/ de'i steng du 'di bsnan te/ 'di thams cad bar do yin snang ba 'di bsgyur bar bya'o snyam pas/ gzugs su snang tshad 'khor lo sdom pa'i skur bsgyur dgos snyam pa byas tsa na/ thams cad he ru ka yab yum du khrong khrong song*/ sgra grags tshad sngags yi ge bdun pa lta bu gcig tu bsgyur snyam pa byas tsa na/ sngags de nyid du 'ur 'ur byung*/ bde sdug chags sdang sogs yid dran rtog yul dang bcas pa thams cad sgyu ma lta bu rmi lam lta bu zhes nyin par drag tu bsgom/ rmi lam shar ba na de nyid du sgyur ba gsum po dran par byas pa tsam gyis nyon mongs sdug bsngal thams cad las rang grol bar 'gyur ro/ / bzhi pa spyi gnad 'chug med ni/ skabs 'dir bla ma phal cher 'di skad gsung ste/ 'dir dbang po tha ma'i yang tha ma zhes spyi gnad 'chug med dbang po dman pa'i nyams len gyi dbang du byas nas/ bshad ma thag pa sprul sku 'gag med kyi dmigs pa yongs rdzogs kho na bsgom pa'i steng du/

'di snon par mdzad pa 'ga' zhig 'dug ste/ lar bar do'i dmigs pa phyi ma gsum po rkang tshugs pa gsum ma yin/ snga ma la phyi ma phyi ma bsnan pa'o/ /zhes gsung ngo*/ /phyogs gcig nas de ltar yin mod kyang*/ de kho nar byas na spyi gnad 'chug med ces pa'i spyi sgra nus med du 'gro bas/ dmigs pa 'di dbang po 'bring gi nyams len la yang snon dgos pa srid/ tha ma'i nyams len la yang snon dgos zhes pa'i don du snang zhing*/ de ltar na bar do rang dbang po rab 'bring gsum gyi nyams len du 'dus pas/ dbang po bzhi pa'i rnam bzhag mi dgos par mngon la/ them yig gi mchan bu dang*/ tshig gsal du'ang*/ spyi gnad 'chug med gsung ba ma gtogs dbang po'i rim pa dang sbyar ba med do/ /des na 'bring dang tha ma'i dmigs pa gang ltar yang rung ste/ dmigs pa 'di bsnan te bsgoms na 'chug pa med ces pa'i don yin par snang ngo*/ /ji skad du/ bla ma yi dam sgyu lus gsum/ /'bral ba med par lam du khyer/ /bar do'i 'jigs pa chen po la/ /'chug pa med pa'i man ngag gces/ /zhes pa ltar/ /bar do'i 'dun pa drag po dang bcas pas/ spyir 'gro ba rigs drug g-i nang nas skye 'gro pho thams cad dang*/ khyad par du zhe sdang skye ba'i yul thams cad rang nyid gnas pa'i chos 'byung gi g.yas zur phyogs su 'khod par bsgom/ mchod pa bzhi rdzogs su phul nas/ bar dor longs sku thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes bya/ yang 'gro ba rigs drug tu gtogs pa'i sems can mo thams cad dang*/ khyad par 'dod chags skye ba'i yul thams cad chos 'byung gi g.yon zur du 'khod par bsgom/ mchod pa bzhi rdzogs su phul nas/ bar dor longs sku thob par mdzad du gsol/ /ces gsol ba btab/ slar yang bla ma'i mos gus dang*/ rang gzhan lha skur gsal ba dang*/ bden med kyi 'dun pa shugs bskyed pas rgyab brten no/ /de ltar yang yang bsgom/ rten bud med kyis bsgom pa'i dbang du byas na/

chags sdang skye ba'i yul go brje bar bya'o/ /yang rang gang du gnas pa'i chos 'byung sngon po de shin tu yangs par bsgoms pa'i g.yas g.yon gyi nang zur du de dag bsgom dgos pa yin na'ang*/ der bsgom mi bde dmigs pa mi gsal na/ de'i thad kyi bar snang nam mkha' thams cad dang phyi rol du'ang bsgom du rung gsung*/ yang bla ma'i zhal nas thog mar rang yi dam de/ chos 'byung gi mdun gyi zur la zhal bstan pa yin kyang*/ skabs 'dir chos 'byung gi rgyab phyogs la zhal bsgyur bas/ rigs drug lha skur bsgyur ba la mdun gyis phyogs par 'ong*/ mchod pa dang gsol 'debs byed dgos pas de ltar bya gsung*/ dmigs skor nga drug pa'o/ /de ltar na dmigs skor lnga bcu nga drug gi steng du stong ra nad gdon sel byed dang*/ sgyu lus dbang po tha ma'i sa bcad phyi ma gnyis dang*/ 'od gsal gyi mthar thug dang*/ rjes kyi sa bcad lnga dang*/ 'pho ba bar do'i dang po re re rnams bsnan pas chos thun drug cu re bdun yin la/ da lta tshig khrid tsam thob chos su byed pa la thun gyi nges pa med do/ /dmigs thun dngos su yod med la ma rag par thun re la dmigs pa re'i tha snyad sbyar nas/ dmigs pa drug cu rtsa bdun ces kyang bya'o/ /na mo gu ru/ zab lam ni gu'i chos drug 'di la/ yan lag mtha' rgyas su ston pa'i rgyas pa dang*/ spyi nye bar bsdus pa'i 'bring por dang*/ don ma tshang med pa'i bsdus pa dang*/ gnad mthil du bsgril ba'i shin tu bsdus pa ste bzhi yod/ dang po ni/ chos drug bka' bcur grags pa'i dbang rnams kyang rdzogs par bskul/ rmi lam gyi khrid rdzogs mtshams su sgyu lus stan thog gcig ma dang*/ 'dzin pa rang grol/ sbyong ba rnam gnyis/ dmigs pa lnga skor sogs dang 'byams gcod rgyas pa nas len gyin 'chad pa yin/ 'od gsal rdzogs mtshams su 'od gsal 'char sgo ngos 'dzin dang lhan thabs su 'bri bar 'gyur ba'i 'dam kha tsho yang ston pa yin ste/

'on kyang phyis kyi phyag len la dmigs pa kha skong de rnams mi byed par gda' dbang rnams rdzogs par bskur ro/ /de la bka' bcu po so so'i dus mtshams skabs su bab pa der bskur bar 'dod na/ dang por bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur/ sngon 'gro spyi dang*/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed song mtshams su/ yid dam 'bogs pa'i tshul yin pas/ bde mchog lha lnga'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang de bskur/ chos drug bka' bcu dngos la mi the yang*/ rgyud sde lnga'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang de yang stong ra'i khrid kyi skabs gang 'os re ru mdzad kyin ni 'dug/sngon 'gro'i khrid tshar gtum mo'i khrid ma tshugs pa'i mtshams der gtum mo'i sgos bka' bskur/ gtum mo dang*/ sgyu lus kyi bar skabs su/ sgyu lus kyi sgos bka' byed/ de dang rmi lam gyi khrid kyi bar du rmi lam gyi sgos bka' byed/ de dang 'od gsal gyi khrid kyi bar du/ 'od gsal gyi sgos bka' byed pa rnams la mi 'dra ba med/ rgyas pa'i skabs 'dir sgyu lus dbang mo che ni/ kha cig bsre ba sgyu lus gyi dkyil gyi thad rang yin gsung nas/ rmi lam sbyong spel gyi skabs gang 'thad du byed/ la la bsre ba'i mjug yin pas gsung 'od gsal gyi dngos gzhi song mtshams su mdzad de khyad chen po rang med na'ang*/ phyi ma 'thad par sems/ de bzhin du 'pho ba dang*/ bar do'i sgos bka' yang so so'i khrid kyi 'gor mdzad pa la mi 'dra ba med/ 'pho ba bar do spyi'i bka' de/ skabs sna tshogs gcig tu byed kyang bar do'i khrid kyi mjug tu byed pa nyid legs so/ bdag gi rnam rtog ltar na/ lha lnga'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur dang*/ rgyud sde lnga'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur gnyis las/ gang rigs gcig kun gyi tha mar byas na legs par 'ong ngo sems so/ /de la chos drug gi bka' bcu ni/ byin rlabs sgo 'byed kyi bka' gny-is/

byin rlabs khog phubs kyi bka' gnyis/ byin rlabs gzhung shing gi bka' drug go /de la bar pa gnyis ni spyi'i bka' gnyis la zer ba dang*/ phyi ma drug ni sgos bka' drug la ngos 'dzin pa la rtsod pa med/ dang po gnyis kyi ngos 'dzin la/ kha cig bde mchog lha lnga dang*/ rgyud sde lnga'i dbang bsdus pa gnyis la 'dod pa yang yod do/ /de ltar 'dod mkhan gyi nang tshan la la ni/ bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang rgyas pa yod pa ma tshor ba yang yin la/ kha cig ni dkyil chog gi gzhung don ma khrol bar dbang bskur byed ma shes par snang*/ gzhan 'ga' ni lha lnga'i dbang bskur che ba ni/ ni gu'i lugs kyi smin byed yin kyang chos drug sgos kyi min pas/ bka' bcu la mi bgrang zer te/ mdor na 'di la phyis byung lag len byed pa nyung bar byung ngo*/ /de'i rgyu ni 'di ltar yin te/ 'gro mgon rin po che'i rjes su/ mkhas grub rnam gsum dngos slob dang bcas pa'i skabs su/ 'di lag len du dar ba yod cing mchod phreng la sogs pa'i lhan thabs 'ga' re mdzad mod/ cho ga dngos zor yang zhing gzhung gzhan la kha 'phangs pa dang lag len khyer bde ba'i stabs/ yi ge gsal po cher ma mdzad par snang*/ de la yang spyir mkhas grub gzhon nu grub ni/ phyi dkyil gcig tu dbang bskur rgyas pa ma song ba la phyag chen chos drug sogs yi mi gnang ba yin par 'dug/

dam bsgrags kyang cher mdzad par gda'/ mkhas grub gzhan gnyis kyis dam sbrags rang ma mdzad kyang phyag len de dang 'dra/ de ltar yin yang phyis kyi rnams sgom chen pa spyi 'di'i mig dkyus shor/ rgyud sde lnga'i dbang chen po 'di lo dang zla ba mang por grabs byas nas lkog bshams pa'i lan re tsam bskur ba ma gtogs/ dbang bzhi rdzogs kyi rigs 'phral 'phral mdzad pa ma lcogs nas/ rang ngam gzhan la dbang rgyas pa gang rung de snga rol nas thob na rab byed/ de min smin byed rgyas pa gzhan ye ma thon cing lha lnga'i smin byed tsam yang ma byas par khrid 'debs pa'i srol cig byung*/ de phyin chad bla chos kyi dbang gis lha lnga rgyas pa la don gnyer cher ma byung ba'i skyon du 'dug/de ni byed ma shes chos drug gi bka' bcu po bgrang dgos byung bas/ lha lnga'i dbang rgyas pa'i tshab la cig shos de bcug pa tsam mo/ /gzhan yang ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lugs 'di la chos drug nyid lam gyi rkang dang rtsa ba yin pas spyi'i smin byed yin nam/ chos drug gi rkang dang 'gal snyam pa'i log rtog mi bya'o/ /des na byin rlabs sgo 'byed kyi bka' gnyis ni/ bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang che chung gnyis yin/ rgyud sde lnga gtso bsdus kyi dbang ni/ yi dam gtad pa yin pas spyi khyab tu gser chos thams cad dang 'brel ba'ang yin mod/ gzhung bka' nyer lnga rang la mi 'brang ngo*/ /de ltar na chos drug nyid la yan lag mtha' rgyas su byed tshul de ltar yin la/ gnyis pa spyi nye bar bsdus pa 'bring ni/ byin rlabs sgo 'byed kyi dbang sgyu lus dbang mo che kho na la bsdu/ de yang deng sang phal cher rjes su byed kyin 'dug na'ang*/ bka' gzhan rnams mi byed pa'i stabs khrid kyi thog mar byas na legs/ sbyong ba rnam gnyis sogs cha lag rnams mi dgos/ khrid dmigs gzhung rkyang de yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'o/ /gsum pa don ma tshang ba med par bsdus pa ni/

sgyu lus dbang mo che de bskur dgos/ khrid tshul 'di la sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi gnyis zhes/ dang po ni dag byed a'i stong ra ste dmigs skor cig/skyabs sems sngon du byed dgos kyang dmigs skor logs su mi 'dren no/ /dngos gzhi la chos drug las/ gtum mo la sngon 'gro lus gnad me'i stong ra/ dngos gzhi gtum mo zas su za ba/ rjes srid pa'i dbang zhu ba ste dmigs skor gsum mo/ /sgyu lus la/ rang lus snang stong lha sku/ cir snang sgyu ma'i lam khyer/ 'gro drug sgyu mar 'char byed de gsum mo/ /rmi lam bzung ba la/ rang zin thig le dbang bzhi'i gnad dang*/ rtog bcas lam khyer gnyis/ sbyong ba la zung du bsdebs pa gang rung*/ gcig go gsungs yang*/ sems kyi lus sbyong ba dang*/ 'dun pas sbyong ba gnyis sdeb/ yul snang gi nang nas thig le yul snang gsal byed de/ rmi lam kyi khrid la rtsa ba'i sa bcad/ bzung ba/ sbyong ba/ yul snang gsum la dmigs skor lnga'o/ / 'od gsal gyi skabs su/ mi rtag skyo shas dang*/ bla ma'i mos gus thun gyi sngon 'gro btang*/ thabs lam rang mdangs dang*/ spyod lam dam rdzas dang*/ lam mkhyer rnams thun mtshams kyi spyod pa la btang*/ bzung ba'i dmigs pa gsum po gang rung zhig bsgom gsungs kyang*/ bla ma la bzung ba kho na lag len gyi mthil du mdzad/ de ltar na 'od gsal gyi khrid la bzung ba dang*/ bsre ba'o/ / bsre ba la gsal stong bsre ba dang*/ nyin mtshan bsre ba'o/ /zhes bsdus don byed de/ gsal stong bsre ba/ nyin mtshan bsre ba ste/ 'od gsal la dmigs pa gsum mo/ /'pho ba la ye shes skar khung ma ste dmigs pa gcig go /bar do la rgyal ba longs sku lam khyer dang*/ gnad 'chug med gnyis bsdoms nas dmigs chen gcig ste/ de ltar na/ chos drug bsdus pa dmigs chen bcu bdun no/ /gnad mthil du dril ba ni stan thog gcig ma ste/ logs su 'chad par 'gyur ro/

/de ltar mkha' 'gro'i gsung gi bcud/ /zab don bla ma'i zhal bum 'di/ /yig bris mang du yod na yang*/ /de dag rnams la ma ltos so/ /zhal rgyun dmar khrid ma chad pa/ /blo la 'thems par byas nas ni/ /yig rnying khungs ma'i sbas skungs rnams/ /mdzub btsugs byed na mkhas pa yin/ /lar ni nyams myong rgyun med na/ khrigs bkod tsam gyis ga la phan/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs nyams myong rgyun/ /sems la thebs pa gal re che/ /zhes pa zab lam ni gu chos drug gi dmigs rim rgyas bsdus gab 'khrugs med par bkod pa 'di yang tā ra nā thas so// //sarba maṅga lam// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/zab lam ni gu chos drug gi khrid yig zab don thang mar brdal ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 314 -- PAGE 313 -- PAGE 213 -
